author: "Camilo Escobar"

  html_document:

    df_print: paged
---

# Purpose and analytical position

This report finalises a site-first interpretation of the Holtemme WGCNA
network. It does not reconstruct the network and does not use chemistry to
select modules. Instead, it follows five ordered questions:

1. Which module eigengenes differ among the six sampling sites or across the
   three predefined river transitions?
2. Which modules retain acceptable membership and eigengene-profile stability
   across a declared 14-network sensitivity scheme?
3. Which biological functions are enriched in the complete gene membership of
   those modules, using the selected WGCNA gene universe as the functional
   background?
4. Which differentially expressed genes and highly connected genes provide
   gene-level support for the module interpretation?
5. Do total predicted mixture pressure or selected mode-of-action (MoA) profiles
   provide compatible chemical context for the independently selected modules?

The network was constructed from 30 individual RNA-seq libraries. Site effects
and planned module-eigengene contrasts are therefore evaluated from individual
library values. Chemistry remains measured once per site; chemistry overlays use
six site means and are treated as secondary, hypothesis-generating context.

Module eigengene signs are mathematically arbitrary. A positive site contrast
means that the module eigengene had a higher value at the numerator site; it does
not by itself mean that every gene in the module was upregulated. Gene-level
expression direction is evaluated separately using the focal differential-
expression contrasts.

The valid non-grey modules multiplied by the three predefined contrasts form the
sole primary inferential family. Omnibus site tests are supplementary, and
chemistry never selects modules.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
write_csv_safe <- function(x, path) {
  readr::write_csv(x, path, na = "")
  invisible(path)
}

save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, stem, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 320) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(stem, ".png"),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(stem, ".pdf"),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
  if (requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      paste0(stem, ".svg"),
      plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  invisible(stem)
}

clean_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  x[!nzchar(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

standardize_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("-", "_", x)
  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "", x)
}

first_informative <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_chr(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & !x %in% c(".", "-", "NA")]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_character_ else x[[1]]
}

first_nonempty <- function(...) {
  values <- list(...)
  target_n <- max(vapply(values, length, integer(1)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, target_n)

  for (value in values) {
    value <- rep_len(clean_chr(value), target_n)
    replace_idx <- is.na(out) & !is.na(value)
    out[replace_idx] <- value[replace_idx]
  }

  out
}

first_or_na <- function(x, default = NA) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(default)
  x[[1]]
}

collapse_unique <- function(x, max_n = Inf) {
  x <- sort(unique(clean_chr(x)))
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(NA_character_)
  paste(utils::head(x, max_n), collapse = " | ")
}

safe_max <- function(x, default = NA_real_) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(default)
  max(x)
}

safe_min <- function(x, default = NA_real_) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(default)
  min(x)
}

fdr_score <- function(x, floor_value = .Machine$double.xmin) {
  -log10(pmax(as.numeric(x), floor_value))
}

safe_abs_max <- function(x, default = NA_real_) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(default)
  max(abs(x))
}

hedges_g_two_group <- function(x_numerator, x_denominator) {
  x_numerator <- as.numeric(x_numerator)
  x_denominator <- as.numeric(x_denominator)
  x_numerator <- x_numerator[is.finite(x_numerator)]
  x_denominator <- x_denominator[is.finite(x_denominator)]

  n_num <- length(x_numerator)
  n_den <- length(x_denominator)

  if (n_num < 2L || n_den < 2L) return(NA_real_)

  var_num <- stats::var(x_numerator)
  var_den <- stats::var(x_denominator)
  pooled_df <- n_num + n_den - 2L
  pooled_var <- (
    (n_num - 1L) * var_num +
      (n_den - 1L) * var_den
  ) / pooled_df

  if (!is.finite(pooled_var) || pooled_var <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  cohen_d <- (
    mean(x_numerator) - mean(x_denominator)
  ) / sqrt(pooled_var)

  correction_j <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (n_num + n_den) - 9)
  correction_j * cohen_d
}

small_sample_correction <- function(df_residual) {
  df_residual <- as.numeric(df_residual)
  if (!is.finite(df_residual) || df_residual <= 1) return(NA_real_)
  1 - 3 / (4 * df_residual - 1)
}

classify_paper_theme <- function(term_text) {
  txt <- tolower(clean_chr(term_text))

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(txt) ~ NA_character_,
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "dna repair|dna damage|chromatin|nucleosome|histone|replication|telomere"
    ) ~ "DNA maintenance, repair, and chromatin organisation",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "ribosom|translation|trna|rna processing|rna splicing|proteas|protein folding|chaperon|unfolded protein"
    ) ~ "Proteostasis, translation, and RNA processing",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "mitochond|atp|oxidative phosphorylation|glycol|citric acid|tca|respiratory|energy|carbohydrate metabolic"
    ) ~ "Energy and primary metabolism",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "lipid|fatty acid|sterol|cholesterol|membrane organisation|membrane organization|phospholipid|isoprenoid"
    ) ~ "Lipid and membrane remodelling",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "ion transport|homeostasis|calcium|potassium|sodium|chloride|proton transport|channel activity|cation transport|anion transport"
    ) ~ "Ion transport and homeostasis",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "development|morphogenesis|adhesion|cytoskelet|actin|microtubule|tubulin|extracellular matrix"
    ) ~ "Development, adhesion, and cytoskeletal remodelling",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "neuro|synap|axon|dendrit|neuron|neurotrans|membrane potential|locomot|behavior|behaviour"
    ) ~ "Neurophysiology and synaptic function",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "immune|inflamm|hemost|haemost|complement|toll|innate|defense response|defence response"
    ) ~ "Immune, inflammatory, and hemostatic responses",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "oxidative|redox|glutathione|peroxidase|superoxide|reactive oxygen|detox|xenobiotic|cytochrome p450"
    ) ~ "Oxidative stress and detoxification",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "vesicle|intracellular transport|protein transport|trafficking|endocyt|exocyt|golgi"
    ) ~ "Transport and intracellular trafficking",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "signal|signaling|signalling|kinase|phosphorylation|receptor|g protein|second messenger"
    ) ~ "Cell signalling and regulation",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "apopt|autophag|catabol|lysosom|cell death|turnover|stress response"
    ) ~ "Cell stress, turnover, and catabolism",
    stringr::str_detect(
      txt,
      "chitin|cuticle|glycosyl hydrolase|cellulase"
    ) ~ "Chitin and carbohydrate remodelling",
    TRUE ~ "Other or unresolved function"
  )
}

fit_module_site_tests <- function(module_tbl, contrast_tbl) {
  current_module_label <- unique(as.character(module_tbl$module_label))
  current_module <- unique(as.character(module_tbl$module))

  module_tbl <- module_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$module_eigengene),
      as.character(.data$site) %in% site_order
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      site = factor(as.character(.data$site), levels = site_order)
    )

  if (nrow(module_tbl) < length(site_order) * 2L) {
    return(list(
      omnibus = tibble::tibble(
        module = current_module,
        module_label = current_module_label,
        n_libraries = nrow(module_tbl),
        n_sites = dplyr::n_distinct(module_tbl$site),
        f_statistic = NA_real_,
        df_site = NA_real_,
        df_residual = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        eta_squared = NA_real_
      ),
      contrasts = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }

  omnibus_model <- stats::lm(
    module_eigengene ~ site,
    data = module_tbl
  )
  omnibus_anova <- stats::anova(omnibus_model)

  ss_site <- as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["Sum Sq"]][1])
  ss_residual <- as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["Sum Sq"]][2])

  omnibus_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    module = current_module,
    module_label = current_module_label,
    n_libraries = nrow(module_tbl),
    n_sites = dplyr::n_distinct(module_tbl$site),
    f_statistic = as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["F value"]][1]),
    df_site = as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["Df"]][1]),
    df_residual = as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["Df"]][2]),
    p_value = as.numeric(omnibus_anova[["Pr(>F)"]][1]),
    eta_squared = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(ss_site + ss_residual) & (ss_site + ss_residual) > 0,
      ss_site / (ss_site + ss_residual),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

  cell_means_model <- stats::lm(
    module_eigengene ~ 0 + site,
    data = module_tbl
  )
  beta_hat <- stats::coef(cell_means_model)
  beta_vcov <- stats::vcov(cell_means_model)
  residual_df <- stats::df.residual(cell_means_model)
  residual_sigma <- summary(cell_means_model)$sigma
  correction_j_model <- small_sample_correction(residual_df)

  contrast_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
    contrast_tbl,
    function(
      contrast,
      contrast_panel,
      numerator_site,
      denominator_site,
      contrast_role
    ) {
      numerator_coef <- paste0("site", numerator_site)
      denominator_coef <- paste0("site", denominator_site)

      contrast_vector <- stats::setNames(
        rep(0, length(beta_hat)),
        names(beta_hat)
      )
      contrast_vector[[numerator_coef]] <- 1
      contrast_vector[[denominator_coef]] <- -1

      estimate <- sum(contrast_vector * beta_hat)
      standard_error <- sqrt(
        as.numeric(
          t(contrast_vector) %*% beta_vcov %*% contrast_vector
        )
      )
      t_statistic <- estimate / standard_error
      p_value <- 2 * stats::pt(
        -abs(t_statistic),
        df = residual_df
      )
      critical_t <- stats::qt(0.975, df = residual_df)

      numerator_values <- module_tbl %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          as.character(.data$site) == .env$numerator_site
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(.data$module_eigengene)

      denominator_values <- module_tbl %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          as.character(.data$site) == .env$denominator_site
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(.data$module_eigengene)

      tibble::tibble(
        module = current_module,
        module_label = current_module_label,
        contrast = contrast,
        contrast_panel = contrast_panel,
        numerator_site = numerator_site,
        denominator_site = denominator_site,
        contrast_role = contrast_role,
        n_numerator = length(numerator_values),
        n_denominator = length(denominator_values),
        mean_numerator = mean(numerator_values, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_denominator = mean(denominator_values, na.rm = TRUE),
        eigengene_difference = estimate,
        standard_error = standard_error,
        confidence_low = estimate - critical_t * standard_error,
        confidence_high = estimate + critical_t * standard_error,
        t_statistic = t_statistic,
        df_residual = residual_df,
        residual_sigma = residual_sigma,
        model_standardized_effect = dplyr::if_else(
          is.finite(residual_sigma) & residual_sigma > 0,
          (estimate / residual_sigma) * correction_j_model,
          NA_real_
        ),
        p_value = p_value,
        pairwise_hedges_g_archival = hedges_g_two_group(
          numerator_values,
          denominator_values
        ),
        # Backward-compatible alias retained for archived downstream tables only.
        hedges_g = hedges_g_two_group(
          numerator_values,
          denominator_values
        )
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    omnibus = omnibus_tbl,
    contrasts = contrast_results
  )
}

run_module_goseq <- function(
  current_module,
  membership_tbl,
  universe_length_tbl,
  mapping_tbl,
  mapping_version
) {
  module_gene_ids <- membership_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$module == .env$current_module) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$gene_id) %>%
    unique()

  selected_vector <- as.integer(
    universe_length_tbl$gene_id %in% module_gene_ids
  )
  names(selected_vector) <- universe_length_tbl$gene_id

  bias_vector <- universe_length_tbl$bias_length
  names(bias_vector) <- universe_length_tbl$gene_id

  mapping_sub <- mapping_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$gene_id %in% universe_length_tbl$gene_id,
      !is.na(.data$category)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$gene_id,
      .data$category,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  annotated_universe <- unique(mapping_sub$gene_id)
  annotated_module <- intersect(module_gene_ids, annotated_universe)

  summary_base <- tibble::tibble(
    module = current_module,
    module_label = paste0("ME", current_module),
    mapping_version = mapping_version,
    n_network_genes = nrow(universe_length_tbl),
    n_module_genes = length(module_gene_ids),
    n_network_genes_with_go = length(annotated_universe),
    n_module_genes_with_go = length(annotated_module)
  )

  if (
    length(module_gene_ids) == 0L ||
      length(annotated_module) < minimum_module_annotated_genes ||
      sum(selected_vector) == 0L ||
      sum(selected_vector) == length(selected_vector)
  ) {
    return(list(
      summary = summary_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          n_tested_terms = 0L,
          n_module_fdr_terms = 0L,
          status = "skipped_low_annotation_or_invalid_selection"
        ),
      full = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }

  gene2cat_list <- split(
    mapping_sub$category,
    mapping_sub$gene_id
  )
  term2genes <- split(
    mapping_sub$gene_id,
    mapping_sub$category
  )

  term_metadata <- mapping_sub %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      term = first_or_na(.data$term, NA_character_),
      ontology = first_or_na(.data$ontology, NA_character_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  pwf <- suppressWarnings(
    goseq::nullp(
      DEgenes = selected_vector,
      bias.data = bias_vector,
      plot.fit = FALSE
    )
  )

  goseq_result <- suppressWarnings(
    goseq::goseq(
      pwf,
      gene2cat = gene2cat_list,
      use_genes_without_cat = FALSE
    )
  )

  full_tbl <- tibble::as_tibble(goseq_result)

  # goseq may already append GO.db term and ontology columns. Keep the mapping
  # metadata under distinct names so a later join cannot silently create
  # term.x/term.y and ontology.x/ontology.y columns.
  if (!"term" %in% names(full_tbl)) full_tbl$term <- NA_character_
  if (!"ontology" %in% names(full_tbl)) full_tbl$ontology <- NA_character_

  term_metadata <- term_metadata %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      mapping_term = .data$term,
      mapping_ontology = .data$ontology
    )

  full_tbl <- full_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = as.character(.data$category)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      term_metadata,
      by = "category"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      term = first_nonempty(.data$mapping_term, .data$term),
      ontology = first_nonempty(
        .data$mapping_ontology,
        .data$ontology
      ),
      module = current_module,
      module_label = paste0("ME", current_module),
      mapping_version = mapping_version,
      n_network_genes = nrow(universe_length_tbl),
      n_module_genes = length(module_gene_ids),
      n_network_genes_with_go = length(annotated_universe),
      n_module_genes_with_go = length(annotated_module),
      module_over_represented_FDR = stats::p.adjust(
        .data$over_represented_pvalue,
        method = "BH"
      ),
      n_module_genes_in_term = as.integer(.data$numDEInCat),
      n_network_genes_in_term = as.integer(.data$numInCat),
      fold_enrichment = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$numInCat > 0 &
          length(annotated_module) > 0 &
          length(annotated_universe) > 0,
        (.data$numDEInCat / length(annotated_module)) /
          (.data$numInCat / length(annotated_universe)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      matched_module_genes = purrr::map_chr(
        .data$category,
        function(current_category) {
          genes_here <- term2genes[[current_category]]
          if (is.null(genes_here)) return("")
          paste(intersect(genes_here, module_gene_ids), collapse = ";")
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(c("mapping_term", "mapping_ontology"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$module_over_represented_FDR,
      dplyr::desc(.data$fold_enrichment)
    )

  summary_tbl <- summary_base %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_tested_terms = nrow(full_tbl),
      n_module_fdr_terms = sum(
        full_tbl$module_over_represented_FDR < 0.05 &
          full_tbl$n_module_genes_in_term >= minimum_module_genes_in_term,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      status = "ran"
    )

  list(
    summary = summary_tbl,
    full = full_tbl
  )
}
```

```{r input-manifest}
manifest_path <- function(column_name) {
  if (!column_name %in% names(selected_network_manifest)) {
    stop("Selected-network manifest lacks required column: ", column_name)
  }
  candidate <- as.character(selected_network_manifest[[column_name]][[1]])
  if (is.na(candidate) || !nzchar(candidate)) {
    stop("Selected-network manifest has an empty path for: ", column_name)
  }
  if (!grepl("^(?:[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|/)", candidate)) {
    candidate <- file.path(project_dir, candidate)
  }
  normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
```

# 2. Network-design transparency and input quality control

This section records what the existing network represents. It does not treat the
scale-free-topology statistic as a measure of network accuracy. The site-first
analysis below asks whether the recovered modules carry reproducible biological
information across the 30 libraries; network construction remains an upstream
unsupervised step.

```{r load-network-inputs}
module_eigengene_sample <- readr::read_csv(
  module_eigengene_sample_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
module_eigengene_site <- readr::read_csv(
  module_eigengene_site_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
module_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  module_summary_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module = as.character(.data$module),
    module_label = dplyr::if_else(
      stringr::str_detect(as.character(.data$module), "^ME"),
      as.character(.data$module),
      paste0("ME", as.character(.data$module))
    )
  )

gene_membership <- readr::read_csv(
  gene_membership_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),
    module = as.character(.data$module),
    module_label = dplyr::if_else(
      stringr::str_detect(as.character(.data$module_label), "^ME"),
      as.character(.data$module_label),
      paste0("ME", as.character(.data$module))
    )
  )

selected_network_gene_n <- dplyr::n_distinct(gene_membership$gene_id)
selected_max_block_size_setting <- if (
  "max_block_size" %in% names(selected_network_manifest)
) {
  as.integer(selected_network_manifest$max_block_size[[1]])
} else {
  selected_network_gene_n
}

for (optional_col in c(
  "best_gene_label",
  "gene_label",
  "EggNM.Preferred_name",
  "EggNM.Description",
  "module_kME_signed",
  "module_kME_abs"
)) {
  if (!optional_col %in% names(gene_membership)) {
    gene_membership[[optional_col]] <- NA
  }
}

gene_membership <- gene_membership %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_gene_label = first_nonempty(
      dplyr::if_else(
        !stringr::str_detect(clean_chr(.data$best_gene_label), "^TRINITY_"),
        .data$best_gene_label,
        NA_character_
      ),
      dplyr::if_else(
        !stringr::str_detect(clean_chr(.data$gene_label), "^TRINITY_"),
        .data$gene_label,
        NA_character_
      ),
      .data$EggNM.Preferred_name,
      stringr::str_trunc(clean_chr(.data$EggNM.Description), width = 55),
      .data$gene_id
    ),
    module_kME_abs = dplyr::coalesce(
      as.numeric(.data$module_kME_abs),
      abs(as.numeric(.data$module_kME_signed))
    )
  )

# Resolve reporting labels independently from GO/KEGG category assignment.
# EggNOG preferred names remain first; Swiss-Prot BLASTP and BLASTX symbols are
# used only when the strongest near-equivalent hits are unambiguous.
label_resolution_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "network_gene_label_resolution.csv"
)
label_resolution_metadata_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "network_gene_label_resolution_metadata.csv"
)

label_input_info <- file.info(c(trinotate_file, gene_membership_file))
label_resolution_signature <- paste(
  paste(
    normalizePath(
      rownames(label_input_info),
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = TRUE
    ),
    label_input_info$size,
    format(
      label_input_info$mtime,
      "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS3Z",
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  ),
  paste0(
    "label_resolver_v2;near_evalue_log10=",
    swissprot_near_equivalent_log10_evalue,
    ";near_identity_points=",
    swissprot_near_equivalent_identity_difference
  ),
  collapse = "||"
)

label_cache_valid <- FALSE
if (
  file.exists(label_resolution_file) &&
    file.exists(label_resolution_metadata_file)
) {
  label_cache_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
    label_resolution_metadata_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  label_cache_valid <- nrow(label_cache_metadata) == 1L &&
    identical(
      as.character(label_cache_metadata$input_signature[[1]]),
      label_resolution_signature
    )
}

if (label_cache_valid) {
  gene_label_resolution <- readr::read_csv(
    label_resolution_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  trinotate_label_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
    trinotate_file,
    col_select = dplyr::all_of(c(
      "#gene_id",
      "transcript_id",
      "sprot_Top_BLASTX_hit",
      "sprot_Top_BLASTP_hit",
      "EggNM.Preferred_name",
      "EggNM.Description",
      "EggNM.max_annot_lvl"
    )),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene_id = `#gene_id`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene_id = standardize_gene_id(.data$gene_id)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$gene_id %in% gene_membership$gene_id)

  trinotate_gene_annotation <- trinotate_label_raw %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$gene_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      eggnog_preferred_name = first_informative(
        .data$EggNM.Preferred_name
      ),
      eggnog_description = first_informative(
        .data$EggNM.Description
      ),
      eggnog_annotation_level = first_informative(
        .data$EggNM.max_annot_lvl
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  swissprot_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    trinotate_label_raw %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        .data$gene_id,
        .data$transcript_id,
        label_source = "swissprot_blastp",
        raw_hit = clean_chr(.data$sprot_Top_BLASTP_hit)
      ),
    trinotate_label_raw %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        .data$gene_id,
        .data$transcript_id,
        label_source = "swissprot_blastx",
        raw_hit = clean_chr(.data$sprot_Top_BLASTX_hit)
      )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$raw_hit),
      !.data$raw_hit %in% c(".", "-", "NA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      swissprot_entry = stringr::str_extract(
        .data$raw_hit,
        "^[^\\^]+"
      ),
      swissprot_symbol = stringr::str_remove(
        .data$swissprot_entry,
        "_.*$"
      ),
      swissprot_evalue = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
        stringr::str_match(
          .data$raw_hit,
          "\\^E:([^\\^]+)"
        )[, 2]
      )),
      swissprot_percent_identity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(
        stringr::str_match(
          .data$raw_hit,
          "\\^([0-9.]+)%ID\\^"
        )[, 2]
      )),
      swissprot_description = clean_chr(
        stringr::str_match(
          .data$raw_hit,
          "RecName: Full=([^;\\^]+)"
        )[, 2]
      ),
      neg_log10_evalue = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(.data$swissprot_evalue),
        -log10(pmax(.data$swissprot_evalue, .Machine$double.xmin)),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$swissprot_symbol),
      nzchar(.data$swissprot_symbol)
    )

  summarise_swissprot_source <- function(source_tbl, source_name) {
    source_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$label_source == .env$source_name) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$gene_id) %>%
      dplyr::group_modify(
        function(.x, .y) {
          ranked <- .x %>%
            dplyr::arrange(
              dplyr::desc(.data$neg_log10_evalue),
              dplyr::desc(.data$swissprot_percent_identity),
              .data$swissprot_entry,
              .data$transcript_id
            )

          best <- ranked %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
          best_log_score <- best$neg_log10_evalue[[1]]
          best_identity <- best$swissprot_percent_identity[[1]]

          near_equivalent <- ranked
          if (is.finite(best_log_score)) {
            near_equivalent <- near_equivalent %>%
              dplyr::filter(
                dplyr::coalesce(
                  .data$neg_log10_evalue >=
                    .env$best_log_score -
                    swissprot_near_equivalent_log10_evalue,
                  FALSE
                )
              )
          } else {
            near_equivalent <- near_equivalent %>%
              dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
          }
          if (is.finite(best_identity)) {
            near_equivalent <- near_equivalent %>%
              dplyr::filter(
                dplyr::coalesce(
                  .data$swissprot_percent_identity >=
                    .env$best_identity -
                    swissprot_near_equivalent_identity_difference,
                  FALSE
                )
              )
          }

          near_symbols <- sort(unique(near_equivalent$swissprot_symbol))
          ambiguous <- length(near_symbols) > 1L

          tibble::tibble(
            swissprot_symbol = dplyr::if_else(
              ambiguous,
              NA_character_,
              best$swissprot_symbol[[1]]
            ),
            swissprot_entry = best$swissprot_entry[[1]],
            swissprot_description = best$swissprot_description[[1]],
            swissprot_evalue = best$swissprot_evalue[[1]],
            swissprot_percent_identity =
              best$swissprot_percent_identity[[1]],
            swissprot_ambiguous = ambiguous,
            swissprot_near_equivalent_symbols = paste(
              near_symbols,
              collapse = ";"
            ),
            n_distinct_source_symbols = dplyr::n_distinct(
              ranked$swissprot_symbol
            )
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }

  blastp_resolution <- summarise_swissprot_source(
    swissprot_long,
    "swissprot_blastp"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
      ~paste0("blastp_", .x),
      -.data$gene_id
    )

  blastx_resolution <- summarise_swissprot_source(
    swissprot_long,
    "swissprot_blastx"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
      ~paste0("blastx_", .x),
      -.data$gene_id
    )

  gene_label_resolution <- tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = gene_membership$gene_id
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      trinotate_gene_annotation,
      by = "gene_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      blastp_resolution,
      by = "gene_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      blastx_resolution,
      by = "gene_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      resolved_gene_label = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$eggnog_preferred_name)) ~
          clean_chr(.data$eggnog_preferred_name),
        !dplyr::coalesce(.data$blastp_swissprot_ambiguous, FALSE) &
          !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_symbol)) ~
          clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_symbol),
        !dplyr::coalesce(.data$blastx_swissprot_ambiguous, FALSE) &
          !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_symbol)) ~
          clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_symbol),
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$eggnog_description)) ~
          stringr::str_trunc(
            clean_chr(.data$eggnog_description),
            width = 65
          ),
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_description)) ~
          stringr::str_trunc(
            clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_description),
            width = 65
          ),
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_description)) ~
          stringr::str_trunc(
            clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_description),
            width = 65
          ),
        TRUE ~ .data$gene_id
      ),
      label_source = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$eggnog_preferred_name)) ~
          "eggnog_preferred_name",
        !dplyr::coalesce(.data$blastp_swissprot_ambiguous, FALSE) &
          !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_symbol)) ~
          "unambiguous_swissprot_blastp_symbol",
        !dplyr::coalesce(.data$blastx_swissprot_ambiguous, FALSE) &
          !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_symbol)) ~
          "unambiguous_swissprot_blastx_symbol",
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$eggnog_description)) ~
          "eggnog_description",
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastp_swissprot_description)) ~
          "swissprot_blastp_description",
        !is.na(clean_chr(.data$blastx_swissprot_description)) ~
          "swissprot_blastx_description",
        TRUE ~ "trinity_gene_id"
      ),
      label_ambiguity_flag = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$blastp_swissprot_ambiguous,
        FALSE
      ) | dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$blastx_swissprot_ambiguous,
        FALSE
      )
    )

  write_csv_safe(gene_label_resolution, label_resolution_file)
  write_csv_safe(
    tibble::tibble(
      input_signature = label_resolution_signature,
      ranking_rule = paste0(
        "lowest e-value, then highest percent identity; labels withheld ",
        "when a different symbol is within ",
        swissprot_near_equivalent_log10_evalue,
        " log10 e-value units and ",
        swissprot_near_equivalent_identity_difference,
        " percentage points identity"
      )
    ),
    label_resolution_metadata_file
  )
}

gene_label_audit <- gene_label_resolution %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$label_source, name = "n_network_genes") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fraction_network_genes = .data$n_network_genes /
      dplyr::n_distinct(gene_label_resolution$gene_id)
  )

write_csv_safe(
  gene_label_audit,
  file.path(tables_dir, "network_gene_label_resolution_audit.csv")
)

gene_membership <- gene_membership %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    upstream_best_gene_label = .data$best_gene_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_label_resolution %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$gene_id,
        .data$resolved_gene_label,
        .data$label_source,
        .data$label_ambiguity_flag,
        dplyr::starts_with("blastp_"),
        dplyr::starts_with("blastx_")
      ),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_gene_label = dplyr::coalesce(
      clean_chr(.data$resolved_gene_label),
      clean_chr(.data$upstream_best_gene_label),
      .data$gene_id
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  gene_label_audit,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Provenance of the reporting labels assigned to the",
    format(selected_network_gene_n, big.mark = ","),
    "network genes; label choice does not alter GOseq statistics."
  )
)

if (!"station_tag" %in% names(module_eigengene_sample)) {
  stop("The individual-library eigengene table must contain station_tag.")
}

me_columns <- intersect(
  names(module_eigengene_sample),
  module_summary$module_label
)
me_columns <- setdiff(me_columns, "MEgrey")

if (length(me_columns) == 0L) {
  me_columns <- grep("^ME", names(module_eigengene_sample), value = TRUE)
  me_columns <- setdiff(me_columns, "MEgrey")
}

if (length(me_columns) == 0L) {
  stop("No assigned module-eigengene columns were found in the sample table.")
}

module_eigengene_long <- module_eigengene_sample %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    site = stringr::str_trim(as.character(.data$station_tag))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$site %in% site_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      "sample_code",
      "site_id",
      "station_tag",
      "display_label",
      "site_name",
      "station_order"
    )),
    .data$site,
    dplyr::all_of(me_columns)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(me_columns),
    names_to = "module_label",
    values_to = "module_eigengene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    site = factor(.data$site, levels = site_order),
    module = stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME")
  )

sample_site_qc <- module_eigengene_sample %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    site = stringr::str_trim(as.character(.data$station_tag))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$site %in% site_order) %>%
  dplyr::count(site, name = "n_libraries") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    site = site_order,
    fill = list(n_libraries = 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(.data$site, site_order))

network_gene_qc <- tibble::tibble(
  n_network_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_membership$gene_id),
  n_assigned_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(
    gene_membership$gene_id[gene_membership$module != "grey"]
  ),
  n_grey_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(
    gene_membership$gene_id[gene_membership$module == "grey"]
  ),
  n_assigned_modules = dplyr::n_distinct(
    gene_membership$module[gene_membership$module != "grey"]
  ),
  n_individual_libraries = dplyr::n_distinct(
    module_eigengene_sample$sample_code
  )
)

declared_minimum_module_size <- if (
  "minimum_module_size" %in% names(selected_network_manifest)
) {
  as.integer(selected_network_manifest$minimum_module_size[[1]])
} else {
  50L
}
declared_network_gene_n <- if (
  "selected_gene_set_size" %in% names(selected_network_manifest)
) {
  as.integer(selected_network_manifest$selected_gene_set_size[[1]])
} else {
  selected_network_gene_n
}
all_me_columns <- grep("^ME", names(module_eigengene_sample), value = TRUE)
assigned_module_sizes <- module_summary$n_genes[module_summary$module != "grey"]

if (nrow(module_eigengene_sample) != 30L) {
  stop("Step 08 requires exactly 30 individual-library eigengene rows.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(module_eigengene_sample$sample_code)) {
  stop("Sample identifiers in the eigengene table must be unique.")
}
if (nrow(sample_site_qc) != 6L || any(sample_site_qc$n_libraries != 5L)) {
  stop("Step 08 requires exactly six sites with five libraries per site.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(gene_membership$gene_id)) {
  stop("Network gene identifiers must be unique.")
}
if (selected_network_gene_n != declared_network_gene_n) {
  stop("Requested and retained final-network gene counts do not match.")
}
if (any(assigned_module_sizes < declared_minimum_module_size)) {
  stop("A valid assigned module is smaller than the declared minimum.")
}
if (!setequal(module_summary$module_label, all_me_columns)) {
  stop("Final module-colour labels do not match eigengene labels.")
}

write_csv_safe(
  sample_site_qc,
  file.path(tables_dir, "sample_site_qc.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  network_gene_qc,
  file.path(tables_dir, "network_gene_qc.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  sample_site_qc,
  caption = "Individual RNA-seq libraries contributing to the module-eigengene site tests."
)
knitr::kable(
  network_gene_qc,
  caption = "Network gene and module coverage."
)
```

```{r network-parameter-table}
soft_threshold_decision <- if (file.exists(soft_threshold_decision_file)) {
  readr::read_csv(
    soft_threshold_decision_file,

} else {

soft_threshold_diagnostics <- if (file.exists(soft_threshold_diagnostics_file)) {
  readr::read_csv(
    soft_threshold_diagnostics_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

selected_power_value <- if (
  nrow(soft_threshold_decision) > 0L &&
    "selected_power" %in% names(soft_threshold_decision)
) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first_or_na(
    soft_threshold_decision$selected_power,
    NA_real_
  )))
} else {
  NA_real_
}
if (length(selected_power_value) != 1L || !is.finite(selected_power_value)) {
  stop(
    "Step 07 selected-power decision is missing or invalid; ",
    "Step 08 will not substitute an implicit network power."
  )
}

stability_power_variants <- sort(unique(pmax(
  1,
  as.integer(selected_power_value) + c(
    -stability_power_offset,
    stability_power_offset
  )
)))

selected_power_fit <- if (
  nrow(soft_threshold_diagnostics) > 0L &&
    all(c("power", "scale_free_fit") %in% names(soft_threshold_diagnostics))
) {

    dplyr::filter(.data$power == .env$selected_power_value) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$scale_free_fit) %>%
    first_or_na(NA_real_)
} else {

}

selected_power_connectivity <- if (
  nrow(soft_threshold_diagnostics) > 0L &&
    all(c("power", "mean_connectivity") %in% names(soft_threshold_diagnostics))
) {
  soft_threshold_diagnostics %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$power == .env$selected_power_value) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$mean_connectivity) %>%
    first_or_na(NA_real_)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

network_parameter_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~parameter, ~value, ~interpretation,
  "Network source", network_source_label,
  "the final network is consumed from the explicit Step 07 handoff",
  "Input expression", "VST values from 30 individual libraries",

  "Gene universe", as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(gene_membership$gene_id)),
  "network represents the selected variance-ranked expression space",
  "Similarity", "biweight midcorrelation; maxPOutliers = 0.10",
  "robust correlation reduces the influence of a limited number of extreme observations",
  "Network type", "signed",
  "positive co-expression is retained; negative correlations approach weak adjacency",
  "Soft-threshold power", as.character(selected_power_value),
  "correlations are continuously reweighted rather than hard-thresholded",
  "Scale-free fit at selected power", format(round(selected_power_fit, 3), nsmall = 3),
  "diagnostic fit to a scale-free connectivity approximation; not network accuracy",
  "Scale-free target reached", if (
    "soft_threshold_target_reached" %in% names(selected_network_manifest)
  ) as.character(selected_network_manifest$soft_threshold_target_reached[[1]]) else "not recorded",
  "the target is a diagnostic criterion and was not used alone to select the network",
  "Mean connectivity at selected power", format(round(selected_power_connectivity, 2), nsmall = 2),
  "average weighted connectivity retained after soft thresholding",
  "Topological overlap", "signed TOM",
  "genes are grouped using direct adjacency and shared network neighbours",
  "Minimum module size", "50 genes",

  "Deep split", if (
    "deep_split" %in% names(selected_network_manifest)
  ) as.character(selected_network_manifest$deep_split[[1]]) else "2",
  "dynamic-tree-cut sensitivity retained from the selected network",

  ) as.character(selected_network_manifest$n_blocks[[1]]) else "not recorded",

write_csv_safe(
```

# 3. Module stability under resampling and parameter variation

Module membership stability is evaluated before modules are interpreted. The
declared scheme contains 14 alternative networks: ten site-stratified
subsamples retaining four of five libraries per site, two full-data soft-power
variants at plus/minus two from the selected power, and two full-data
merge-height variants (0.15 and 0.35).
Each reference module is matched to the alternative module with the greatest
gene-membership Jaccard index. Absolute eigengene-profile agreement is evaluated
after projecting each alternative assignment onto all 30 libraries.

The diagnostic is descriptive rather than a preservation significance test.
`high` and `moderate` modules pass the stability gate; `low` modules can be shown
as exploratory patterns but cannot support a paper-facing module claim. Cached
results are reused only when the source files, WGCNA version, random seed, and
declared settings have an identical fingerprint.

```{r module-stability}
stability_variant_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "module_stability_by_variant.csv"
)
stability_summary_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "module_stability_summary.csv"
)
stability_design_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "module_stability_design.csv"
)
stability_metadata_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "module_stability_run_metadata.csv"
)
stability_expression_qc_file <- file.path(
  tables_dir,
  "selected_network_expression_variance_qc.csv"
)

file_fingerprint <- function(path) {
  info <- file.info(path)
  paste(
    normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
    info$size,
    as.character(unname(tools::md5sum(path))),
    sep = "::"
  )
}

canonicalize_scheme_signature <- function(signature) {
  components <- strsplit(as.character(signature), "||", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  components <- vapply(components, function(component) {
    if (!grepl("::", component, fixed = TRUE)) return(component)
    fields <- strsplit(component, "::", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    fields[[1]] <- basename(fields[[1]])
    paste(fields, collapse = "::")
  }, character(1))
  paste(components, collapse = "||")
}

stability_scheme_signature <- paste(
  file_fingerprint(vst_matrix_file),
  file_fingerprint(metadata_matched_file),
  file_fingerprint(gene_membership_file),
  paste0("WGCNA=", as.character(utils::packageVersion("WGCNA"))),
  paste0("seed=", stability_seed),
  paste0("resamples=", stability_resample_replicates),
  paste0("libraries_per_site=", stability_libraries_per_site),
  paste0("reference_power=", selected_power_value),
  paste0("power_variants=", paste(stability_power_variants, collapse = ";")),
  paste0("merge_variants=", paste(stability_merge_variants, collapse = ";")),
  paste0("max_block_size=", selected_max_block_size_setting),
  "finalisation_helper=validated_network_v1",
  "network=signed",
  "cor=bicor",
  "maxPOutliers=0.1",
  "minModuleSize=50",
  "deepSplit=2",
  "referenceMergeCutHeight=0.25",
  "pamRespectsDendro=FALSE",
  sep = "||"
)

expected_stability_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
  scheme_signature = stability_scheme_signature,
  stability_status = "complete",
  stability_scheme = "10 site-stratified subsamples plus 4 parameter variants",
  reference_power = selected_power_value,
  random_seed = stability_seed,
  wgcna_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("WGCNA"))
)

stability_cache_present <- all(file.exists(c(
  stability_variant_file,
  stability_summary_file,
  stability_design_file,
  stability_metadata_file,
  stability_expression_qc_file
)))

stability_cache_valid <- FALSE
if (reuse_module_stability_cache && stability_cache_present) {
  cached_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
    stability_metadata_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  stability_cache_valid <- nrow(cached_metadata) == 1L &&
    identical(
      canonicalize_scheme_signature(
        as.character(cached_metadata$scheme_signature[[1]])
      ),
      canonicalize_scheme_signature(stability_scheme_signature)
    ) &&
    identical(
      as.character(cached_metadata$stability_status[[1]]),
      "complete"
    )
}

if (run_module_stability && !stability_cache_valid) {
  stability_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
    metadata_matched_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      sample_code = as.character(.data$sample_code),
      site = clean_chr(.data$station_tag)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$site %in% site_order)

  stability_sample_codes <- module_eigengene_sample %>%
    dplyr::filter(clean_chr(.data$station_tag) %in% site_order) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$sample_code) %>%
    as.character()

  stability_metadata <- stability_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$sample_code %in% stability_sample_codes) %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(stability_sample_codes, .data$sample_code))

  if (
    nrow(stability_metadata) != length(stability_sample_codes) ||
      any(is.na(stability_metadata$sample_code)) ||
      any(table(stability_metadata$site) < stability_libraries_per_site)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The matched metadata cannot support the declared site-stratified ",
      "module-stability design."
    )
  }

  vst_stability <- readr::read_tsv(
    vst_matrix_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$gene_id,
      dplyr::all_of(stability_sample_codes)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  reference_gene_ids <- gene_membership$gene_id
  gene_match <- match(reference_gene_ids, vst_stability$gene_id)
  if (any(is.na(gene_match))) {
    stop("The VST matrix is missing one or more reference-network genes.")
  }

  stability_expression <- as.matrix(
    vst_stability[gene_match, stability_sample_codes]
  )
  storage.mode(stability_expression) <- "double"
  rownames(stability_expression) <- reference_gene_ids
  dat_expr_stability <- t(stability_expression)
  rownames(dat_expr_stability) <- stability_sample_codes

  selected_expression_variance <- matrixStats::colVars(dat_expr_stability)
  network_expression_variance_qc <- tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = colnames(dat_expr_stability),
    expression_variance = selected_expression_variance,
    finite_positive_variance = is.finite(selected_expression_variance) &
      selected_expression_variance > 0
  )
  if (any(!network_expression_variance_qc$finite_positive_variance)) {
    stop("Every final-network gene must have finite positive expression variance.")
  }
  write_csv_safe(
    network_expression_variance_qc,
    stability_expression_qc_file
  )

  reference_colors <- stats::setNames(
    as.character(gene_membership$module),
    as.character(gene_membership$gene_id)
  )[colnames(dat_expr_stability)]

  if (any(is.na(reference_colors))) {
    stop("Reference module colours could not be aligned to the VST matrix.")
  }

  reference_me <- module_eigengene_sample %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(stability_sample_codes, .data$sample_code)) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(me_columns)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(reference_me) <- stability_sample_codes

  set.seed(stability_seed)
  resample_design <- purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_len(stability_resample_replicates),
    function(resample_id) {
      retained_samples <- stability_metadata %>%
        dplyr::group_by(.data$site) %>%
        dplyr::slice_sample(n = stability_libraries_per_site) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::arrange(match(.data$site, site_order), .data$sample_code) %>%
        dplyr::pull(.data$sample_code)

      tibble::tibble(
        variant = sprintf("site_stratified_resample_%02d", resample_id),
        variant_type = "site_stratified_subsample",
        power = selected_power_value,
        merge_cut_height = 0.25,
        sample_codes_list = list(retained_samples)
      )
    }
  )

  parameter_design <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(
      variant = paste0("full_data_power_", stability_power_variants),
      variant_type = "power_sensitivity",
      power = stability_power_variants,
      merge_cut_height = 0.25
    ),
    tibble::tibble(
      variant = paste0("full_data_merge_", stability_merge_variants),
      variant_type = "merge_height_sensitivity",
      power = selected_power_value,
      merge_cut_height = stability_merge_variants
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_codes_list = rep(
        list(stability_sample_codes),
        dplyr::n()
      )
    )

  stability_design <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    resample_design,
    parameter_design
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_samples = purrr::map_int(.data$sample_codes_list, length),
      sample_codes = purrr::map_chr(
        .data$sample_codes_list,
        ~paste(.x, collapse = ";")
      )
    )

  reference_modules <- sort(setdiff(unique(reference_colors), "grey"))
  stability_variant_cache_dir <- file.path(
    objects_dir,
    "module_stability_variant_cache"
  )
  dir.create(
    stability_variant_cache_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  run_stability_variant <- function(
    variant,
    variant_type,
    power,
    merge_cut_height,
    sample_codes_list,
    n_samples,
    sample_codes
  ) {
    variant_cache_signature <- paste(
      stability_scheme_signature,
      variant,
      variant_type,
      power,
      merge_cut_height,
      sample_codes,
      sep = "||"
    )
    variant_cache_file <- file.path(
      stability_variant_cache_dir,
      paste0(
        variant,
        "_",
        digest::digest(variant_cache_signature, algo = "xxhash64"),
        ".rds"
      )
    )
    if (reuse_module_stability_cache && file.exists(variant_cache_file)) {
      cached_variant <- readRDS(variant_cache_file)
      if (
        is.list(cached_variant) &&
          identical(
            cached_variant$scheme_signature,
            variant_cache_signature
          ) &&
          inherits(cached_variant$result, "data.frame")
      ) {
        message("Reusing stability variant cache: ", variant)
        return(cached_variant$result)
      }
    }

    message("Running stability variant: ", variant)
    variant_expression <- dat_expr_stability[
      match(sample_codes_list, rownames(dat_expr_stability)),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    variant_network <- wgcna_run_validated_network(
      dat_expr = variant_expression,
      power = power,
      network_type = "signed",
      correlation_type = "bicor",
      max_p_outliers = 0.1,
      minimum_module_size = 50L,
      merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
      deep_split = 2,
      pam_respects_dendro = FALSE,
      max_block_size = selected_max_block_size_setting,
      verbose = 0
    )

    variant_colors <- variant_network$colors
    variant_modules <- sort(setdiff(unique(variant_colors), "grey"))

    projected_me <- wgcna_orient_eigengenes(
      dat_expr_stability,
      colors = variant_colors,
      max_p_outliers = 0.1
    )$eigengenes

    variant_result <- wgcna_match_modules(
      reference_colors = reference_colors,
      alternative_colors = variant_colors,
      reference_eigengenes = reference_me,
      projected_alternative_eigengenes = projected_me,
      max_p_outliers = 0.1
    ) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        variant = .env$variant,
        variant_type = .env$variant_type,
        n_samples = .env$n_samples,
        power = .env$power,
        merge_cut_height = .env$merge_cut_height,
        .data$reference_module,
        matched_module = .data$alternative_module,
        reference_module_size = .data$reference_n,
        matched_module_size = .data$alternative_n,
        .data$intersection_n,
        .data$jaccard,
        .data$eigengene_abs_correlation,
        .data$reciprocal_match,
        .data$matching_status,
        .data$references_matching_alternative_n,
        n_variant_modules = length(variant_modules),
        n_variant_blocks = variant_network$n_blocks,
        n_variant_undersized_raw_modules = length(
          variant_network$module_audit$raw_module[
            variant_network$module_audit$below_declared_minimum
          ]
        )
      )

    rm(variant_network, projected_me)
    invisible(gc())
    saveRDS(
      list(
        scheme_signature = variant_cache_signature,
        result = variant_result
      ),
      variant_cache_file,
      compress = FALSE
    )
    variant_result
  }

  module_stability_by_variant <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
    stability_design,
    run_stability_variant
  )

  module_stability_summary <- module_stability_by_variant %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$reference_module) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_variants = dplyr::n(),
      median_jaccard_all = stats::median(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      minimum_jaccard_all = safe_min(.data$jaccard),
      median_eigengene_abs_correlation_all = stats::median(
        .data$eigengene_abs_correlation,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      median_jaccard_resampling = stats::median(
        .data$jaccard[
          .data$variant_type == "site_stratified_subsample"
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      minimum_jaccard_resampling = safe_min(
        .data$jaccard[
          .data$variant_type == "site_stratified_subsample"
        ]
      ),
      median_jaccard_parameter = stats::median(
        .data$jaccard[
          .data$variant_type != "site_stratified_subsample"
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      minimum_jaccard_parameter = safe_min(
        .data$jaccard[
          .data$variant_type != "site_stratified_subsample"
        ]
      ),
      reciprocal_match_fraction = mean(
        .data$reciprocal_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      one_to_many_or_merged_variant_n = sum(
        .data$matching_status == "one_to_many_or_merged",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      module = .data$reference_module,
      module_label = paste0("ME", .data$reference_module),
      stability_class = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$median_jaccard_resampling >=
          stability_high_resampling_jaccard &
          .data$median_jaccard_parameter >=
          stability_high_parameter_jaccard &
          .data$minimum_jaccard_all >=
          stability_high_minimum_jaccard &
          .data$median_eigengene_abs_correlation_all >=
          stability_high_eigengene_agreement ~ "high",
        .data$median_jaccard_resampling >=
          stability_moderate_resampling_jaccard &
          .data$median_jaccard_parameter >=
          stability_moderate_parameter_jaccard &
          .data$minimum_jaccard_all >=
          stability_moderate_minimum_jaccard &
          .data$median_eigengene_abs_correlation_all >=
          stability_minimum_eigengene_agreement ~ "moderate",
        TRUE ~ "low"
      ),
      stability_gate_pass = .data$stability_class %in% c("high", "moderate"),
      stability_source = "regenerated_declared_14_network_scheme"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$module,
      .data$module_label,
      dplyr::everything(),
      -.data$reference_module
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(.data$stability_class, c("high", "moderate", "low")),
      dplyr::desc(.data$median_jaccard_resampling)
    )

  write_csv_safe(
    module_stability_by_variant,
    stability_variant_file
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    module_stability_summary,
    stability_summary_file
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    stability_design %>%
      dplyr::select(-.data$sample_codes_list),
    stability_design_file
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    expected_stability_metadata,
    stability_metadata_file
  )
} else if (run_module_stability && stability_cache_valid) {
  module_stability_by_variant <- readr::read_csv(
    stability_variant_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  module_stability_summary <- readr::read_csv(
    stability_summary_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  stability_design <- readr::read_csv(
    stability_design_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  network_expression_variance_qc <- readr::read_csv(
    stability_expression_qc_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  module_stability_by_variant <- tibble::tibble()
  stability_design <- tibble::tibble()
  module_stability_summary <- module_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$module != "grey") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      module = as.character(.data$module),
      module_label = as.character(.data$module_label),
      n_variants = 0L,
      median_jaccard_all = NA_real_,
      minimum_jaccard_all = NA_real_,
      median_eigengene_abs_correlation_all = NA_real_,
      median_jaccard_resampling = NA_real_,
      minimum_jaccard_resampling = NA_real_,
      median_jaccard_parameter = NA_real_,
      minimum_jaccard_parameter = NA_real_,
      stability_class = "not_evaluated",
      stability_gate_pass = FALSE,
      stability_source = "not_run"
    )
  network_expression_variance_qc <- tibble::tibble()
}

stability_threshold_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~stability_class, ~median_resampling_jaccard, ~median_parameter_jaccard,
  ~minimum_jaccard_all, ~median_eigengene_agreement, ~paper_facing_gate,
  "high", ">= 0.75", ">= 0.75", ">= 0.50", ">= 0.90", "pass",
  "moderate", ">= 0.50", ">= 0.50", ">= 0.25", ">= 0.80", "pass",
  "low", "below moderate rule", "below moderate rule",
  "below moderate rule", "below moderate rule", "fail"
)

write_csv_safe(

  file.path(tables_dir, "module_stability_classification_rules.csv")
```

# 4. Primary site association of module eigengenes

The three planned contrasts are the sole primary WGCNA test family.
Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied once across the dynamically determined
family of valid non-grey modules multiplied by three contrasts. The omnibus site
tests are a supplementary overview and cannot independently select a module.
Adjustment within each contrast is also exported as a diagnostic, not as a
second inferential route.

Because the modules were derived from these same 30 expression profiles, these
p-values are exploratory measures of site structure rather than validation in an
independent dataset.

```{r module-site-models}
module_test_list <- module_eigengene_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  purrr::map(
    fit_module_site_tests,
    contrast_tbl = planned_contrasts
  )

module_site_omnibus <- purrr::map_dfr(
  module_test_list,
  "omnibus"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    site_q = stats::p.adjust(.data$p_value, method = "BH"),
    site_fdr_supported = .data$site_q < site_fdr_threshold
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        module_size = .data$n_genes
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$site_q, dplyr::desc(.data$eta_squared))

module_planned_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  module_test_list,
  "contrasts"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q_global_planned = stats::p.adjust(
      .data$p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q_within_contrast = stats::p.adjust(
      .data$p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contrast_fdr_supported = .data$q_global_planned < contrast_fdr_threshold,
    large_nominal_effect =
      abs(.data$model_standardized_effect) >= large_effect_abs_standardized &
      .data$p_value < nominal_p_threshold,
    eigengene_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$eigengene_difference > 0 ~ "higher_at_numerator_site",
      .data$eigengene_difference < 0 ~ "lower_at_numerator_site",
      TRUE ~ "no_difference"
    ),
    effect_size_reporting = paste(
      "model_standardized_effect is paper-facing;",
      "pairwise_hedges_g_archival is diagnostic only"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        module_size = .data$n_genes
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(.data$contrast, planned_contrasts$contrast),
    .data$q_global_planned,
    .data$p_value,
    dplyr::desc(abs(.data$eigengene_difference))
  )

valid_assigned_module_n <- length(me_columns)
expected_primary_test_family_n <- valid_assigned_module_n *
  nrow(planned_contrasts)
if (nrow(module_planned_contrasts) != expected_primary_test_family_n) {
  stop(
    "Primary test-family size mismatch: expected ",
    expected_primary_test_family_n,
    " valid-module-by-contrast tests but obtained ",
    nrow(module_planned_contrasts),
    "."
  )
}
if (anyDuplicated(
  module_planned_contrasts[c("module_label", "contrast")]
)) {
  stop("Each valid module/contrast combination must occur exactly once.")
}

write_csv_safe(

write_csv_safe(
```

```{r module-site-summary}
contrast_module_summary <- module_planned_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module, .data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_abs_standardized_effect = safe_abs_max(
      .data$model_standardized_effect

    max_abs_hedges_g_archival = safe_abs_max(
      .data$pairwise_hedges_g_archival
    ),
    min_planned_p = safe_min(.data$p_value),
    min_global_planned_q = safe_min(.data$q_global_planned),
    n_global_fdr_contrasts = sum(
      .data$q_global_planned < contrast_fdr_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_large_nominal_contrasts = sum(
      .data$large_nominal_effect,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    global_fdr_contrasts = collapse_unique(
      .data$contrast[
        .data$q_global_planned < contrast_fdr_threshold
      ]
    ),
    large_effect_contrasts = collapse_unique(
      .data$contrast[
        .data$large_nominal_effect
      ]
    ),
    leading_contrast = first_or_na(
      .data$contrast[
        order(
          .data$q_global_planned,
          .data$p_value,
          -abs(.data$eigengene_difference)
        )
      ],
      NA_character_
    ),
    leading_contrast_standardized_effect = first_or_na(
      .data$model_standardized_effect[
        order(
          .data$q_global_planned,
          .data$p_value,
          -abs(.data$eigengene_difference)
        )
      ],
      NA_real_
    ),
    leading_contrast_hedges_g_archival = first_or_na(
      .data$pairwise_hedges_g_archival[
        order(
          .data$q_global_planned,
          .data$p_value,
          -abs(.data$eigengene_difference)
        )
      ],
      NA_real_
    ),
    leading_contrast_q = first_or_na(
      .data$q_global_planned[
        order(
          .data$q_global_planned,
          .data$p_value,
          -abs(.data$eigengene_difference)
        )
      ],
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

module_site_summary <- module_site_omnibus %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    contrast_module_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")

  dplyr::left_join(
    module_stability_summary,

      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 ~
        "planned_contrast_FDR",
      .data$n_large_nominal_contrasts > 0 ~
        "exploratory_large_nominal_contrast_effect",

      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 &

      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 &
        !.data$stability_gate_pass ~
        "planned_contrast_FDR_but_stability_fail",
      .data$n_large_nominal_contrasts > 0 &
        .data$stability_gate_pass ~
        "exploratory_large_effect_and_stability_pass",
      .data$n_large_nominal_contrasts > 0 ~
        "exploratory_large_effect_but_stability_fail",
      TRUE ~ "limited_primary_evidence"
    ),
    omnibus_role = "supplementary_overview_only"

  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$primary_site_stability_status,

        "planned_contrast_FDR_and_stability_pass",
        "planned_contrast_FDR_but_stability_fail",
        "exploratory_large_effect_and_stability_pass",
        "exploratory_large_effect_but_stability_fail",
        "limited_primary_evidence"
      )
    ),
    .data$min_global_planned_q,
    dplyr::desc(.data$max_abs_standardized_effect)
  )
```

## Contrast-level robustness of the retained modules

Module membership stability does not by itself demonstrate that a focal site
contrast is insensitive to individual organisms. The three FDR-supported,
stability-gated modules are therefore evaluated through leave-one-individual-out
refitting, site-stratified bootstrap resampling, and exact two-group permutation.
These are sensitivity diagnostics; the globally adjusted planned contrast
remains the primary inferential test.

```{r focal-module-contrast-robustness}
focal_module_contrasts <- tibble::tribble(
  ~module_label, ~contrast, ~intended_role,
  "MEturquoise", "HOL02_vs_HOL01", "main_if_contrast_robust",
  "MEgreen", "HOL05_vs_HOL04", "main",
  "MEmagenta", "HOL05_vs_HOL04", "supplementary"
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    planned_contrasts %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$contrast,
        .data$contrast_panel,
        .data$numerator_site,
        .data$denominator_site
      ),
    by = "contrast"
  )

if (!"sample_code" %in% names(module_eigengene_long)) {
  stop("Contrast robustness requires sample_code in the eigengene table.")
}

fit_single_module_contrast <- function(
  module_tbl,
  contrast,
  contrast_panel,
  numerator_site,
  denominator_site
) {
  contrast_row <- tibble::tibble(
    contrast = contrast,
    contrast_panel = contrast_panel,
    numerator_site = numerator_site,
    denominator_site = denominator_site,
    contrast_role = "contrast_sensitivity"
  )
  fit_module_site_tests(module_tbl, contrast_row)$contrasts %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
}

exact_mean_difference_test <- function(
  module_tbl,
  numerator_site,
  denominator_site
) {
  focal_tbl <- module_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(.data$site) %in% c(
        .env$numerator_site,
        .env$denominator_site
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_numerator = as.character(.data$site) == .env$numerator_site
    )

  values <- focal_tbl$module_eigengene
  n_numerator <- sum(focal_tbl$is_numerator)
  n_total <- length(values)
  if (n_total > 20L) {
    stop("Exact contrast enumeration is limited to 20 focal observations.")
  }

  observed <- mean(values[focal_tbl$is_numerator]) -
    mean(values[!focal_tbl$is_numerator])
  combinations <- utils::combn(seq_len(n_total), n_numerator)
  permutation_differences <- apply(
    combinations,
    2,
    function(numerator_index) {
      mean(values[numerator_index]) - mean(values[-numerator_index])
    }
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    exact_observed_difference = observed,
    exact_permutation_p = mean(
      abs(permutation_differences) >=
        abs(observed) - sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)
    ),
    exact_permutation_n = length(permutation_differences)
  )
}

run_contrast_robustness <- function(
  module_label,
  contrast,
  contrast_panel,
  numerator_site,
  denominator_site,
  intended_role
) {
  module_tbl <- module_eigengene_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == .env$module_label)

  base_fit <- fit_single_module_contrast(
    module_tbl,
    contrast,
    contrast_panel,
    numerator_site,
    denominator_site
  )

  focal_samples <- module_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(.data$site) %in% c(
        .env$numerator_site,
        .env$denominator_site
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$sample_code, .data$site)

  loo_estimates <- purrr::map_dfr(
    focal_samples$sample_code,
    function(omitted_sample) {
      fit_single_module_contrast(
        module_tbl %>%
          dplyr::filter(.data$sample_code != .env$omitted_sample),
        contrast,
        contrast_panel,
        numerator_site,
        denominator_site
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          omitted_sample = omitted_sample,
          omitted_site = as.character(
            focal_samples$site[
              focal_samples$sample_code == omitted_sample
            ][[1]]
          )
        )
    }
  )

  bootstrap_estimates <- numeric(contrast_bootstrap_replicates)
  for (bootstrap_iteration in seq_len(contrast_bootstrap_replicates)) {
    bootstrap_tbl <- module_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$site) %>%
      dplyr::group_modify(
        ~dplyr::slice_sample(.x, n = nrow(.x), replace = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    bootstrap_estimates[[bootstrap_iteration]] <-
      fit_single_module_contrast(
        bootstrap_tbl,
        contrast,
        contrast_panel,
        numerator_site,
        denominator_site
      )$eigengene_difference[[1]]
  }

  base_direction <- sign(base_fit$eigengene_difference[[1]])
  loo_direction_consistency <- mean(
    sign(loo_estimates$eigengene_difference) == base_direction
  )
  bootstrap_direction_consistency <- mean(
    sign(bootstrap_estimates) == base_direction
  )
  bootstrap_quantiles <- stats::quantile(
    bootstrap_estimates,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )
  exact_test <- exact_mean_difference_test(
    module_tbl,
    numerator_site,
    denominator_site
  )

  robustness_pass <-
    loo_direction_consistency >= contrast_loo_direction_threshold &&
    bootstrap_direction_consistency >=
      contrast_bootstrap_direction_threshold

  list(
    summary = dplyr::bind_cols(
      tibble::tibble(
        module_label = module_label,
        contrast = contrast,
        contrast_panel = contrast_panel,
        numerator_site = numerator_site,
        denominator_site = denominator_site,
        intended_role = intended_role,
        n_focal_individuals = nrow(focal_samples),
        base_eigengene_difference = base_fit$eigengene_difference[[1]],
        base_confidence_low = base_fit$confidence_low[[1]],
        base_confidence_high = base_fit$confidence_high[[1]],
        model_standardized_effect =
          base_fit$model_standardized_effect[[1]],
        loo_min_difference = min(loo_estimates$eigengene_difference),
        loo_max_difference = max(loo_estimates$eigengene_difference),
        loo_direction_consistency = loo_direction_consistency,
        bootstrap_replicates = contrast_bootstrap_replicates,
        bootstrap_confidence_low = bootstrap_quantiles[[1]],
        bootstrap_median = bootstrap_quantiles[[2]],
        bootstrap_confidence_high = bootstrap_quantiles[[3]],
        bootstrap_direction_consistency =
          bootstrap_direction_consistency,
        contrast_robustness_pass = robustness_pass
      ),
      exact_test
    ),
    loo = loo_estimates %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        module_label = module_label,
        contrast = contrast
      ),
    bootstrap = tibble::tibble(
      module_label = module_label,
      contrast = contrast,
      bootstrap_iteration = seq_len(contrast_bootstrap_replicates),
      bootstrap_eigengene_difference = bootstrap_estimates
    )
  )
}

robustness_objects <- purrr::pmap(

)

      .data$contrast_panel,

      .data$base_confidence_low,
      .data$base_confidence_high,
      .data$model_standardized_effect,
      .data$loo_direction_consistency,
      .data$bootstrap_direction_consistency,
      .data$bootstrap_confidence_low,
      .data$bootstrap_confidence_high,
      .data$exact_permutation_p,
      .data$q_global_planned,
      .data$contrast_robustness_pass
    ),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Contrast sensitivity of the three FDR-supported, stability-gated",
    "modules. Exact permutation p-values are descriptive and do not replace",
    "the globally adjusted planned tests."
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  paper_module_decision_site %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$module_label,

      .data$contrast_robustness_pass,
      .data$paper_role
    ),

  caption = paste(

  )
)
```

# 5. Differential-expression overlap in the focal contrasts

Differential-expression evidence is not used to define the WGCNA modules or to
calculate the site tests. It is added afterward to determine whether genes in a
site-associated module were independently supported by the focal DE analyses and
whether their gene-level direction was coherent.

```{r focal-deg-overlap}
read_focal_deg <- function(contrast_id) {
  deg_file <- file.path(
    r03,
    "contrast_tables",
    contrast_id,
    paste0(contrast_id, "_significant_DEGs.csv")
  )

  if (!file.exists(deg_file)) {
    stop("Missing required focal DEG contrast file: ", deg_file)
  }

  deg_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
    deg_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  required_deg_columns <- c("gene_id", "padj", "log2FoldChange_shrunk")
  missing_deg_columns <- setdiff(required_deg_columns, names(deg_tbl))
  if (length(missing_deg_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing required column(s) in focal DEG file ", deg_file, ": ",
      paste(missing_deg_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  if (!"direction" %in% names(deg_tbl)) {
    deg_tbl$direction <- NA_character_
  }
  if (!"log2FoldChange_shrunk" %in% names(deg_tbl)) {
    deg_tbl$log2FoldChange_shrunk <- NA_real_
  }
  if (!"padj" %in% names(deg_tbl)) {
    deg_tbl$padj <- NA_real_
  }

  deg_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$padj),
      .data$padj < 0.05,
      is.finite(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
      abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= 1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      contrast = contrast_id,
      source_file = normalizePath(deg_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(.data$direction) & nzchar(.data$direction) ~ .data$direction,
        .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ "up_in_numerator",
        .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0 ~ "down_in_numerator",
        TRUE ~ "no_change"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "gene_id",
        "contrast",
        "source_file",
        "direction",
        "log2FoldChange_shrunk",
        "padj"
      ))
    )
}

focal_deg_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  planned_contrasts$contrast,
  read_focal_deg
)

focal_deg_input_audit <- focal_deg_tbl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast, .data$source_file) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    final_deg_n = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$gene_id),
    criteria = "padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= 1",
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::right_join(
    planned_contrasts %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$contrast,
        .data$numerator_site,
        .data$denominator_site
      ),
    by = "contrast"
  )

if (
  nrow(focal_deg_input_audit) != nrow(planned_contrasts) ||
    any(is.na(focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n)) ||
    focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n[
      focal_deg_input_audit$contrast == "HOL05_vs_HOL04"
    ] == 0L
) {
  stop("All three focal DEG contrasts, including H6-H5, must be non-empty.")
}
write_csv_safe(
  focal_deg_input_audit,
  file.path(tables_dir, "focal_deg_input_audit.csv")
)

assigned_gene_membership <- gene_membership %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$gene_id,
    .data$module,
    .data$module_label,
    .data$module_kME_signed,
    .data$module_kME_abs,
    .data$best_gene_label
  )

module_deg_observed <- assigned_gene_membership %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    focal_deg_tbl,
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$module,
    .data$module_label,
    .data$contrast
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_significant_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$gene_id),
    n_higher_at_numerator = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$gene_id[
        .data$direction %in% c(
          "up_in_numerator", "up", "Up", "UP", "higher"
        )
      ]
    ),
    n_lower_at_numerator = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$gene_id[
        .data$direction %in% c(
          "down_in_numerator", "down", "Down", "DOWN", "lower"
        )
      ]
    ),
    median_abs_log2fc = stats::median(
      abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    top_deg_gene_labels = collapse_unique(
      .data$best_gene_label[
        order(-abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk))
      ],
      max_n = 8
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

module_deg_overlap <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  module_label = sort(unique(assigned_gene_membership$module_label)),
  contrast = planned_contrasts$contrast
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module = stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_deg_observed,
    by = c("module", "module_label", "contrast")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        module_size = .data$n_genes
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    planned_contrasts,
    by = "contrast"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_significant_genes = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$n_significant_genes,
      0L
    ),
    n_higher_at_numerator = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$n_higher_at_numerator,
      0L
    ),
    n_lower_at_numerator = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$n_lower_at_numerator,
      0L
    ),
    fraction_module_significant = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$module_size > 0,
      .data$n_significant_genes / .data$module_size,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(.data$contrast, planned_contrasts$contrast),
    dplyr::desc(.data$n_significant_genes)
  )

write_csv_safe(
  focal_deg_tbl,
  file.path(tables_dir, "focal_contrast_significant_degs.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  module_deg_overlap,
  file.path(tables_dir, "module_focal_deg_overlap.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  module_deg_overlap %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_significant_genes > 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$contrast_panel,
      .data$module_label,
      .data$module_size,
      .data$n_significant_genes,
      .data$n_higher_at_numerator,
      .data$n_lower_at_numerator,
      .data$fraction_module_significant,
      .data$median_abs_log2fc
    ),
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Differential-expression overlap of assigned modules in the three focal contrasts."
)
```
