# 6. Whole-module GO enrichment

The functional target is the complete gene membership of each assigned module.
The background is the same selected gene universe that was eligible to enter the
WGCNA network. This avoids comparing a variance-selected module against the much
larger expression-filtered transcriptome.

The primary analysis uses the EggNOG-derived gene-to-GO mapping already prepared
in Step 04. GOseq is used with median gene-level transcript length as a bias proxy.
Module-level FDR is calculated within each complete module enrichment, while a
global FDR across all module-term tests is exported as a conservative sensitivity
column. The broader Trinotate union is processed identically as a declared
sensitivity analysis. GO identifiers are audited against the current local
`GO.db` before either analysis; obsolete or unknown identifiers are retained in
an audit table but excluded when no explicit local replacement is available.

```{r prepare-module-enrichment-inputs}
gene_lengths <- readr::read_csv(
  gene_length_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),
    bias_length = as.numeric(.data$bias_length)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$bias_length),
    .data$bias_length > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

network_universe_lengths <- gene_membership %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$gene_id) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gene_lengths %>%
      dplyr::select(.data$gene_id, .data$bias_length),
    by = "gene_id"
  )

if (nrow(network_universe_lengths) != dplyr::n_distinct(gene_membership$gene_id)) {
  stop(
    "Not every WGCNA network gene has a valid bias length. ",
    "Inspect the Step 04 gene-length reconstruction before module enrichment."
  )
}

gene_to_go_primary_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  gene_to_go_primary_file,
  col_select = dplyr::all_of(c("gene_id", "category")),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),
    category = as.character(.data$category)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$gene_id %in% network_universe_lengths$gene_id,
    !is.na(.data$category)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$gene_id,
    .data$category,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

gene_to_go_union_raw <- if (
  run_sensitivity_union_mapping &&
    file.exists(gene_to_go_union_file)
) {
  readr::read_csv(
    gene_to_go_union_file,
    col_select = dplyr::all_of(c("gene_id", "category")),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),
      category = as.character(.data$category)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$gene_id %in% network_universe_lengths$gene_id,
      !is.na(.data$category)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$gene_id,
      .data$category,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = character(),
    category = character()
  )
}

all_input_go_ids <- sort(unique(c(
  gene_to_go_primary_raw$category,
  gene_to_go_union_raw$category
)))

current_go_metadata <- suppressMessages(
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db::GO.db,
    keys = all_input_go_ids,
    columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY"),
    keytype = "GOID"
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$GOID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    category = as.character(.data$GOID),
    term = clean_chr(.data$TERM),
    ontology = clean_chr(.data$ONTOLOGY)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$category),
    !is.na(.data$term),
    !is.na(.data$ontology)
  )

obsolete_go_ids <- intersect(
  all_input_go_ids,
  AnnotationDbi::mappedkeys(GO.db::GOOBSOLETE)
)

go_identifier_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  original_go_id = all_input_go_ids
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    current_go_id = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$original_go_id %in% current_go_metadata$category,
      .data$original_go_id,
      NA_character_
    ),
    identifier_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$original_go_id %in% current_go_metadata$category ~
        "current_GO.db_identifier",
      .data$original_go_id %in% obsolete_go_ids ~
        "obsolete_no_explicit_local_replacement",
      TRUE ~ "not_recognised_by_current_GO.db"
    ),
    action = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$current_go_id) ~ "retained_for_goseq",
      TRUE ~ "excluded_with_audit_trail"
    ),
    replacement_note = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$current_go_id) ~ "current identifier retained",
      .data$identifier_status ==
        "obsolete_no_explicit_local_replacement" ~
        paste(
          "GO.db marks the identifier obsolete but does not expose a",
          "defensible replaced_by relationship"
        ),
      TRUE ~ "no current local GO graph record"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    current_go_metadata %>%
      dplyr::rename(current_go_id = .data$category),
    by = "current_go_id"
  )

clean_go_mapping <- function(raw_mapping, mapping_version) {
  cleaned <- raw_mapping %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      go_identifier_audit %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$action == "retained_for_goseq") %>%
        dplyr::select(
          category = .data$original_go_id,
          .data$current_go_id
        ),
      by = "category"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .data$gene_id,
      category = .data$current_go_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .data$category) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      current_go_metadata,
      by = "category"
    )

  audit <- tibble::tibble(
    mapping_version = mapping_version,
    n_input_gene_go_links = nrow(raw_mapping),
    n_clean_gene_go_links = nrow(cleaned),
    n_excluded_gene_go_links = nrow(raw_mapping) - nrow(cleaned),
    n_input_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(raw_mapping$gene_id),
    n_clean_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(cleaned$gene_id),
    n_input_go_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(raw_mapping$category),
    n_clean_go_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(cleaned$category)
  )

  list(mapping = cleaned, audit = audit)
}

primary_go_clean <- clean_go_mapping(
  gene_to_go_primary_raw,
  "primary_eggnog"
)
union_go_clean <- clean_go_mapping(
  gene_to_go_union_raw,
  "sensitivity_union"
)

gene_to_go_primary <- primary_go_clean$mapping
gene_to_go_union <- union_go_clean$mapping
go_mapping_cleaning_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  primary_go_clean$audit,
  union_go_clean$audit
)

write_csv_safe(
  go_identifier_audit,
  file.path(tables_dir, "go_identifier_current_status_audit.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  go_mapping_cleaning_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "go_mapping_cleaning_summary.csv")
)

gene_to_kegg_pathway <- if (
  run_supportive_kegg && file.exists(gene_to_kegg_pathway_file)
) {
  readr::read_csv(
    gene_to_kegg_pathway_file,

      gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),

      !is.na(.data$category)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .data$category, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

mapping_coverage <- tibble::tibble(
  mapping_version = c(
    "primary_eggnog",
    "sensitivity_union"
  ),
  mapping_requested = c(
    TRUE,
    run_sensitivity_union_mapping

    nrow(gene_to_go_union)
  )
)

write_csv_safe(
  mapping_coverage,
  file.path(tables_dir, "module_enrichment_mapping_coverage.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  mapping_coverage,
  caption = paste0(
    "GO annotation coverage within the ",
    format(selected_network_gene_n, big.mark = ","),
    "-gene WGCNA universe."
  )
)
knitr::kable(
  go_mapping_cleaning_summary,
  caption = paste(
    "Audit of current, obsolete, and unrecognised GO identifiers before",
    "GOseq and Wang semantic reduction."
  )
)
```

```{r run-whole-module-goseq}
assigned_modules <- module_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$module) %>%
  as.character()

primary_module_goseq_list <- purrr::map(
  assigned_modules,
  function(current_module) {
    run_module_goseq(
      current_module = current_module,
      membership_tbl = gene_membership,
      universe_length_tbl = network_universe_lengths,
      mapping_tbl = gene_to_go_primary,
      mapping_version = "primary_eggnog"
    )
  }
)

module_goseq_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  primary_module_goseq_list,
  "summary"
)
module_goseq_full <- purrr::map_dfr(
  primary_module_goseq_list,
  "full"
)

if (
  run_sensitivity_union_mapping &&
    nrow(gene_to_go_union) > 0L
) {
  union_module_goseq_list <- purrr::map(
    assigned_modules,
    function(current_module) {
      run_module_goseq(
        current_module = current_module,
        membership_tbl = gene_membership,
        universe_length_tbl = network_universe_lengths,
        mapping_tbl = gene_to_go_union,
        mapping_version = "sensitivity_union"
      )
    }
  )

  module_goseq_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    module_goseq_summary,
    purrr::map_dfr(union_module_goseq_list, "summary")
  )
  module_goseq_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    module_goseq_full,
    purrr::map_dfr(union_module_goseq_list, "full")
  )
}

# retained in exports; graphical scores use one order of magnitude below the
# smallest positive FDR in the corresponding family as a transparent floor.
positive_go_fdr <- module_goseq_significant$module_over_represented_FDR[
  is.finite(module_goseq_significant$module_over_represented_FDR) &
    module_goseq_significant$module_over_represented_FDR > 0
]

  max(.Machine$double.xmin, min(positive_go_fdr) / 10)
} else {
  .Machine$double.xmin
}

]

  max(.Machine$double.xmin, min(positive_kegg_fdr) / 10)
} else {
  .Machine$double.xmin
}
```

## Ontology-specific Wang semantic reduction

RRvGO-style reduction is applied only after GOseq significance testing. BP, MF,
and CC are reduced separately using Wang similarity from the current GO graph.
The similarity calculation is topology based and therefore does not import
annotation frequencies from an unrelated organism `OrgDb`. The clustering and
representative-term structure follows RRvGO: terms are hierarchically clustered
from their semantic-similarity matrix and the term with the largest
`-log10(module-wide FDR)` score represents each cluster. This step reduces
redundancy; it is not a new significance test or module-selection route.

```{r ontology-specific-wang-reduction}
wang_similarity_matrix <- function(go_ids, ontology) {
  go_ids <- unique(as.character(go_ids))
  wang_method <- getFromNamespace("wangMethod", "GOSemSim")
  similarity <- wang_method(go_ids, go_ids, ontology)
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)
  similarity[!is.finite(similarity)] <- 0
  diag(similarity) <- 1
  similarity
}

reduce_module_ontology_terms <- function(term_tbl) {
  term_tbl <- term_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$ontology %in% c("BP", "MF", "CC"),
      !is.na(.data$category),
      !is.na(.data$term)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      representative_score = fdr_score(
        .data$module_over_represented_FDR,
        go_fdr_score_floor
      )
    )

  if (nrow(term_tbl) == 0L) return(tibble::tibble())

  if (nrow(term_tbl) < rrvgo_minimum_terms) {
    return(
      term_tbl %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          go = .data$category,
          term = .data$term,
          ontology = .data$ontology,
          cluster = dplyr::row_number(),
          representative_go = .data$category,
          representative_term = .data$term,
          score = .data$representative_score,
          term_similarity_to_representative = 1,
          reduction_status = "raw_terms_below_reduction_minimum",
          semantic_method = "Wang_GO_graph_topology",
          dissimilarity_cut_height = rrvgo_dissimilarity_cut_height
        )
    )
  }

  similarity <- wang_similarity_matrix(
    term_tbl$category,
    unique(term_tbl$ontology)[[1]]
  )
  go_ids <- rownames(similarity)
  scores <- stats::setNames(
    term_tbl$representative_score[match(go_ids, term_tbl$category)],
    go_ids
  )
  clusters <- stats::cutree(
    stats::hclust(stats::as.dist(1 - similarity)),
    h = rrvgo_dissimilarity_cut_height
  )
  representative_by_cluster <- tapply(
    names(clusters),
    clusters,
    function(cluster_terms) {
      cluster_scores <- scores[cluster_terms]
      sort(
        cluster_terms,
        decreasing = FALSE
      )[which.max(
        cluster_scores[sort(cluster_terms, decreasing = FALSE)]
      )]
    }
  )
  representative_go <- as.character(unname(
    representative_by_cluster[as.character(clusters)]
  ))

  tibble::tibble(
    go = names(clusters),
    cluster = as.integer(clusters),
    representative_go = representative_go,
    score = as.numeric(scores[names(clusters)]),
    term_similarity_to_representative = vapply(
      seq_along(clusters),
      function(i) {
        similarity[names(clusters)[[i]], representative_go[[i]]]
      },
      numeric(1)
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      term_tbl %>%
        dplyr::select(
          go = .data$category,
          .data$term,
          .data$ontology
        ),
      by = "go"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      term_tbl %>%
        dplyr::select(
          representative_go = .data$category,
          representative_term = .data$term
        ),
      by = "representative_go"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      reduction_status = "Wang_semantic_reduction",
      semantic_method = "Wang_GO_graph_topology",
      dissimilarity_cut_height = rrvgo_dissimilarity_cut_height
    )
}

rrvgo_group_list <- module_goseq_significant %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$ontology %in% c("BP", "MF", "CC")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$module,
    .data$module_label,
    .data$ontology
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_split()

module_rrvgo_terms <- purrr::map_dfr(
  rrvgo_group_list,
  function(group_tbl) {
    group_key <- group_tbl %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        .data$ontology
      )

    reduced <- reduce_module_ontology_terms(group_tbl)
    if (nrow(reduced) == 0L) return(tibble::tibble())

    reduced %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        module = group_key$module[[1]],
        module_label = group_key$module_label[[1]],
        ontology = group_key$ontology[[1]],
        cluster_id = paste(
          group_key$module_label[[1]],
          group_key$ontology[[1]],
          .data$cluster,
          sep = "::"
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        .data$ontology,
        .data$cluster_id,
        dplyr::everything()
      )
  }
)

module_rrvgo_representatives <- module_rrvgo_terms %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$go == .data$representative_go) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(

    .data$ontology,
    .data$cluster_id
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    representative_go = dplyr::first(.data$representative_go),
    representative_term = dplyr::first(.data$representative_term),
    representative_score = dplyr::first(.data$score),
    n_terms_in_cluster = sum(
      module_rrvgo_terms$cluster_id == dplyr::first(.data$cluster_id)
    ),
    reduction_status = dplyr::first(.data$reduction_status),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  ) %>%

      ),

  ) %>%

rrvgo_cluster_traceback <- rrvgo_term_gene_traceback %>%
```

```{r rrvgo-representative-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=10}
    file.path(plots_dir, "whole_module_rrvgo_representative_terms"),
    width = 13,
    height = 10
  )
  rrvgo_representative_plot
} else {
  cat("No site-associated module had primary GO terms eligible for semantic reduction.\n")
}
```

# 7. Site-first module selection and detailed functional dossiers

The primary paper-facing gate requires both a globally FDR-supported planned
contrast and acceptable module stability. Whole-module functional enrichment,
DEG overlap, and interpretable hubs determine whether a gate-passing module has
enough biological content for detailed interpretation. When a contrast has no
FDR-supported module, its two leading absolute effects remain visible as an
explicitly exploratory ranking; neither the omnibus tests nor chemistry can
promote those modules into the primary family.

```{r select-modules-for-dossiers}
module_dossier_seed <- module_site_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_functional_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_rrvgo_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    site_function_status = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 &
        .data$stability_gate_pass &
        .data$n_significant_go_terms > 0 ~
        "primary_FDR_stable_and_whole_module_function",
      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 &
        .data$stability_gate_pass ~
        "primary_FDR_stable_without_GO_FDR",
      .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0 &
        !.data$stability_gate_pass ~
        "primary_site_FDR_but_stability_gate_failed",
      .data$site_evidence_status ==
        "exploratory_large_nominal_contrast_effect" &
        .data$stability_gate_pass &
        .data$n_significant_go_terms > 0 ~
        "exploratory_large_effect_stable_and_functional",
      .data$site_evidence_status ==
        "exploratory_large_nominal_contrast_effect" ~
        "exploratory_site_pattern",
      .data$n_significant_go_terms > 0 ~
        "whole_module_function_without_site_signal",
      TRUE ~ "context_only"
    )
  )

priority_module_labels <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  module_dossier_seed %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$site_function_status %in% c(
        "primary_FDR_stable_and_whole_module_function",
        "primary_FDR_stable_without_GO_FDR",
        "primary_site_FDR_but_stability_gate_failed",
        "exploratory_large_effect_stable_and_functional",
        "exploratory_site_pattern"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$module_label),
  module_planned_contrasts %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$q_global_planned,
      .data$p_value,
      dplyr::desc(abs(.data$eigengene_difference)),
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 2) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$module_label)
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = maximum_profile_modules) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$module_label)

priority_module_summary <- module_dossier_seed %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label %in% priority_module_labels) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$site_function_status,
      c(
        "primary_FDR_stable_and_whole_module_function",
        "primary_FDR_stable_without_GO_FDR",
        "primary_site_FDR_but_stability_gate_failed",
        "exploratory_large_effect_stable_and_functional",
        "exploratory_site_pattern",
        "whole_module_function_without_site_signal",
        "context_only"
      )
    ),
    .data$min_global_planned_q,
    dplyr::desc(.data$max_abs_standardized_effect)
  )

write_csv_safe(
  priority_module_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "priority_site_first_modules.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  priority_module_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$module_label,
      .data$module_size,
      .data$site_evidence_status,
      .data$min_global_planned_q,
      .data$max_abs_standardized_effect,
      .data$leading_contrast,
      .data$leading_contrast_standardized_effect,
      .data$stability_class,
      .data$median_jaccard_resampling,
      .data$minimum_jaccard_all,
      .data$stability_gate_pass,
      .data$n_significant_go_terms,
      .data$leading_theme,
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "leading_rrvgo_terms_BP",
        "leading_rrvgo_terms_MF",
        "leading_rrvgo_terms_CC"
      )),
      .data$site_function_status
    ),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Site-first modules retained for detailed functional inspection;",
    "effect-size ranking uses the six-site model-standardized contrast."
  )
)
```

## Supportive whole-module KEGG enrichment

KEGG pathways are tested as a separate supportive family using the EggNOG
gene-to-pathway mapping prepared in Step 04, the same selected WGCNA background,
and the same length-bias correction. KEGG does not determine module selection and is
not subjected to GO semantic reduction. Local pathway identifiers are retained
verbatim where no versioned local pathway-name catalogue is available.


# 8. Hub genes, DEG support, and enriched-term traceback

Hub status describes strong membership in the module's dominant expression
profile. It does not show that a hub gene responds directly to a chemical or MoA.
The gene dossier therefore keeps module connectivity, focal DEG support, and
whole-module functional traceback as separate evidence columns.

```{r build-priority-gene-dossiers}

priority_top_hubs <- priority_gene_dossier %>%
```

```{r load-chemistry-context}
chemistry_cor_test <- function(x, y) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  n_sites <- length(x)
  if (n_sites < 4L || stats::sd(x) <= 0 || stats::sd(y) <= 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      correlation = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, n_sites = n_sites,
      loso_median_r = NA_real_, loso_min_abs_r = NA_real_,
      loso_sign_consistency = NA_real_, loso_n_valid = 0L
    ))
  }
  test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson"))
  full_r <- unname(as.numeric(test$estimate))
  loso_r <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_along(x), function(omit_i) {
    retained <- seq_along(x) != omit_i
    if (stats::sd(x[retained]) <= 0 || stats::sd(y[retained]) <= 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    stats::cor(x[retained], y[retained])
  })
  loso_r <- loso_r[is.finite(loso_r)]
  tibble::tibble(
    correlation = full_r,
    p_value = as.numeric(test$p.value),
    n_sites = n_sites,
    loso_median_r = if (length(loso_r)) stats::median(loso_r) else NA_real_,
    loso_min_abs_r = if (length(loso_r)) min(abs(loso_r)) else NA_real_,
    loso_sign_consistency = if (length(loso_r) && full_r != 0) {
      mean(sign(loso_r) == sign(full_r))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    loso_n_valid = length(loso_r)
  )
}

chemistry_me_columns <- setdiff(
  grep("^ME", names(module_eigengene_site), value = TRUE),
  "MEgrey"
)

module_site_long <- module_eigengene_site %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    site = dplyr::any_of("station_tag")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(site = as.character(.data$site)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$site,
    dplyr::all_of(chemistry_me_columns)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -.data$site,
    names_to = "module_label",
    values_to = "module_eigengene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module = stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME"))

compute_chemistry_associations <- function(trait_long) {
  tidyr::expand_grid(
    module_label = sort(unique(module_site_long$module_label)),
    trait = sort(unique(trait_long$trait))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      result = purrr::map2(.data$module_label, .data$trait, function(me, tr) {
        paired <- module_site_long %>%
          dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == .env$me) %>%
          dplyr::inner_join(
            trait_long %>% dplyr::filter(.data$trait == .env$tr),
            by = "site"
          )
        chemistry_cor_test(paired$module_eigengene, paired$trait_value)
      })
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(.data$result) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(module = stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME")) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$module, dplyr::everything())
}

if (chemistry_inputs_available) {
  stu_context <- readr::read_tsv(stu_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(site = 1) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      site = as.character(.data$site),
      trait = "log10_STU_ToxC",
      trait_value = as.numeric(.data$log10_STU_ToxC)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$site %in% chemistry_sites)

  moa_raw_context <- readr::read_tsv(moa_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      site = as.character(.data$sites),
      trait = stringr::str_squish(as.character(.data$MoA_broad_01)),
      trait_value = as.numeric(.data$total_TU)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$site %in% chemistry_sites,
      .data$trait %in% primary_moa
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$site, .data$trait) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(trait_value = sum(.data$trait_value), .groups = "drop")

  moa_context <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    site = chemistry_sites,
    trait = primary_moa
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(moa_raw_context, by = c("site", "trait")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(trait_value = dplyr::coalesce(.data$trait_value, 0))

  module_total_pressure_context <- compute_chemistry_associations(stu_context) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q_total_pressure_context = stats::p.adjust(.data$p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      module_summary %>% dplyr::select(.data$module, module_size = .data$n_genes),
      by = "module"
    )

  trait_wide <- moa_context %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$trait,
      values_from = .data$trait_value,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stu_context %>% dplyr::select(.data$site, log10_STU_ToxC = .data$trait_value),
      by = "site"
    )

  moa_redundancy_context <- purrr::map_dfr(primary_moa, function(moa_name) {
    other_moa <- setdiff(primary_moa, moa_name)
    cor_total <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(
      trait_wide[[moa_name]], trait_wide$log10_STU_ToxC,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ))
    other_cor <- purrr::map_dbl(other_moa, function(other_name) {
      suppressWarnings(stats::cor(
        trait_wide[[moa_name]], trait_wide[[other_name]],
        use = "complete.obs"
      ))
    })
    max_other <- if (any(is.finite(other_cor))) {
      max(abs(other_cor[is.finite(other_cor)]))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      moa = moa_name,
      cor_with_log10_STU = cor_total,
      max_abs_cor_with_other_primary_moa = max_other,
      profile_specificity_status = dplyr::case_when(
        is.finite(cor_total) && abs(cor_total) >= 0.90 ~
          "closely_tracks_total_pressure",
        is.finite(max_other) && max_other >= 0.90 ~
          "closely_tracks_another_primary_moa",
        is.finite(cor_total) && abs(cor_total) >= 0.75 ~
          "partly_redundant_profile",
        is.finite(max_other) && max_other >= 0.75 ~
          "partly_redundant_profile",
        TRUE ~ "comparatively_distinct_profile"
      )
    )
  })

  module_moa_context <- compute_chemistry_associations(moa_context) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q_global_primary = stats::p.adjust(.data$p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      moa_redundancy_context,
      by = c("trait" = "moa")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      module_summary %>% dplyr::select(.data$module, module_size = .data$n_genes),
      by = "module"
    )

  write_csv_safe(
    module_total_pressure_context,
    file.path(tables_dir, "module_log10STU_context_associations.csv")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    module_moa_context,
    file.path(tables_dir, "primary_module_moa_associations.csv")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    moa_redundancy_context,
    file.path(tables_dir, "primary_moa_profile_redundancy_summary.csv")
  )
} else {
  module_total_pressure_context <- tibble::tibble()
  module_moa_context <- tibble::tibble()
  moa_redundancy_context <- tibble::tibble()
}

chemistry_overlay_status <- tibble::tibble(
  network_source = network_source_label,
  chemistry_inputs_available = chemistry_inputs_available,
  total_pressure_associations_computed = nrow(module_total_pressure_context) > 0L,
  moa_associations_computed = nrow(module_moa_context) > 0L,
  moa_redundancy_diagnostics_computed = nrow(moa_redundancy_context) > 0L,
  chemistry_used_for_module_selection = FALSE
)

write_csv_safe(
  chemistry_overlay_status,
  file.path(tables_dir, "chemistry_overlay_status.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  chemistry_overlay_status,
  caption = "Availability and analytical role of the chemistry overlay."
)
```

```{r integrated-module-dossiers}
module_deg_summary <- module_deg_overlap %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module, .data$module_label) %>%

    max_focal_deg_count = safe_max(.data$n_significant_genes, 0),

      .data$fraction_module_significant,

      ]

    ),
    n_top_hubs_with_focal_deg = sum(

  )

module_kegg_dossier_summary <- priority_kegg_pathway_dossiers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module, .data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_significant_kegg_pathways = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$pathway_id),

integrated_module_dossiers <- priority_module_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_deg_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_hub_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_kegg_dossier_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    total_pressure_summary,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    top_moa_by_module,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    evidence_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$site_function_status ==
        "primary_FDR_stable_and_whole_module_function" &
        dplyr::coalesce(.data$max_focal_deg_count, 0) > 0 ~
        "primary_site_FDR_stability_function_and_DEG",
      .data$site_function_status ==
        "primary_FDR_stable_and_whole_module_function" ~
        "primary_site_FDR_stability_and_function",
      .data$site_function_status ==
        "primary_FDR_stable_without_GO_FDR" ~
        "primary_site_FDR_and_stability_only",
      .data$site_function_status ==
        "primary_site_FDR_but_stability_gate_failed" ~
        "site_FDR_but_stability_failed",
      .data$site_function_status ==
        "exploratory_large_effect_stable_and_functional" &
        dplyr::coalesce(.data$max_focal_deg_count, 0) > 0 ~
        "exploratory_effect_stability_function_and_DEG",
      .data$n_significant_go_terms > 0 &
        dplyr::coalesce(.data$max_focal_deg_count, 0) > 0 ~
        "exploratory_function_and_DEG_support",
      .data$site_evidence_status != "limited_site_evidence" ~
        "exploratory_site_pattern_support",
      TRUE ~ "context_only"
    ),
    interpretation_boundary = paste(
      "Site association and functional enrichment identify coordinated",
      "biological programmes; chemistry provides compatible hypotheses",
      "but not causal attribution."
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(
      .data$evidence_tier,
      c(
        "primary_site_FDR_stability_function_and_DEG",
        "primary_site_FDR_stability_and_function",
        "primary_site_FDR_and_stability_only",
        "site_FDR_but_stability_failed",
        "exploratory_effect_stability_function_and_DEG",
        "exploratory_function_and_DEG_support",
        "exploratory_site_pattern_support",
        "context_only"
      )
    ),
    .data$min_global_planned_q,
    dplyr::desc(.data$max_abs_standardized_effect)
  )

write_csv_safe(

      dplyr::select(
```

```{r paper-facing-added-value}
        .data$n_lower_at_numerator,
        .data$fraction_module_significant
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label", "contrast")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_functional_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(

        .data$n_significant_go_terms,

    kegg_added_value,
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module, .data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_supported_transitions = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$contrast),
    transition_scope = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$n_supported_transitions > 1L,
      "multiple_predefined_transitions",
      "one_predefined_transition"
    ),
    direction_differs_among_supported_transitions =
      dplyr::n_distinct(sign(.data$eigengene_difference)) > 1L
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_significant_genes = dplyr::coalesce(.data$n_significant_genes, 0L),
    n_non_deg_module_genes = .data$module_size - .data$n_significant_genes,
    deg_directional_coherence = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$n_significant_genes > 0L,
      pmax(
        .data$n_higher_at_numerator,
        .data$n_lower_at_numerator
      ) / .data$n_significant_genes,
      NA_real_
    ),
    predominant_deg_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$n_higher_at_numerator > .data$n_lower_at_numerator ~
        "higher_at_numerator_site",
      .data$n_lower_at_numerator > .data$n_higher_at_numerator ~
        "lower_at_numerator_site",
      .data$n_significant_genes == 0L ~ "no_focal_DEGs",
      TRUE ~ "balanced"
    ),
    n_significant_go_terms = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$n_significant_go_terms,
      0L
    ),
    n_significant_kegg_pathways = dplyr::coalesce(
      .data$n_significant_kegg_pathways,
      0L
    ),
    wgcna_added_value = paste(
      "complete-module coordination, including",
      .data$n_non_deg_module_genes,
      "genes outside the focal DEG set; individual-library eigengene variation"
    ),
    echo_go_comparison_scope = paste(
      "overlapped with or was compatible with contrast-specific EchoGO;",
      "provides a complementary transcriptomic summary"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(.data$contrast, planned_contrasts$contrast),
    .data$q_global_planned,
    .data$module_label
  )
```

# 11. Final paper-facing WGCNA figure

The final figure is restricted to modules that pass the global planned-contrast
FDR, the declared membership-stability gate, and the contrast-level robustness
check. The green module is required. The turquoise module is included only when
its H3–H2 contrast retains direction in every focal leave-one-out refit and in at
least 95% of site-stratified bootstrap samples. The magenta module is reported
separately because its sparse annotation does not support pathway-level
interpretation.

```{r final-paper-facing-wgcna-figure, fig.width=14, fig.height=11.4, out.width="100%"}
module_plot_colours <- c(
  MEturquoise = "#33B7B7",
  MEgreen = "#238B45",
  MEmagenta = "#C03CB4"
)

module_composition <- focal_module_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$module_label,
    .data$contrast
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_deg_overlap %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module_label,
        .data$contrast,
        n_focal_deg = .data$n_significant_genes
      ),
    by = c("module_label", "contrast")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module_label,
        module_size = .data$n_genes
      ),
    by = "module_label"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_focal_deg = dplyr::coalesce(.data$n_focal_deg, 0L),
    n_non_deg_module_genes = .data$module_size - .data$n_focal_deg,
    focal_deg_fraction = .data$n_focal_deg / .data$module_size
  )

# The dictionary is deliberately short and explicit. Every assignment is
# exported with the source GO term and contributing module genes.
generic_go_parent_pattern <- paste0(
  "^(binding|molecular function|molecular_function|biological process|",
  "biological_process|cellular process|biological regulation|",
  "metabolic process|biosynthetic process|cellular metabolic process|",
  "organelle|intracellular organelle|membrane-bounded organelle|",
  "intracellular membrane-bounded organelle|intracellular anatomical ",
  "structure|cytoplasm|cytosol|cellular component|",
  "cellular anatomical entity)$"
)

paper_function_dictionary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~module_label, ~family_order, ~functional_family, ~term_pattern,
  "MEgreen", 1L, "Carbohydrate and glycoside processing",
  "carbohydrate|glycos|fucose|amylase|polysaccharide|chitin",
  "MEgreen", 2L, "Extracellular and lysosomal hydrolysis",
  "extracellular|lysosom|hydrolase|peptidase|proteolysis|catabolic",
  "MEgreen", 3L, "Cell-projection organisation and recognition",
  "cell projection|axon|morphogenesis|cell recognition",
  "MEturquoise", 1L, "Membrane transport and localisation",
  paste0(
    "transmembrane transport|transporter activity|amide transport|",
    "ion transport|cellular locali[sz]ation|protein locali[sz]ation|",
    "endomembrane"
  ),
  "MEturquoise", 2L, "Cell signalling",
  paste0(
    "cell-cell signaling|cell-cell signalling|signal transduction|",
    "receptor signaling|receptor signalling|second messenger|",
    "calcium-mediated signaling|calcium-mediated signalling"
  ),
  "MEturquoise", 3L, "Development and cytoskeletal organisation",
  "development|morphogenesis|cytoskeleton|cell projection|adhesion|axon guidance",
  "MEturquoise", 4L, "Cellular maintenance and turnover",
  paste0(
    "protein folding|proteolysis|catabolic|autophag|ubiquitin|",
    "organelle organi[sz]ation|cellular component biogenesis"
  )
)

assign_paper_function_family <- function(module_label, term_name) {
  candidate_tbl <- paper_function_dictionary %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == .env$module_label) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$family_order)
  detected <- which(vapply(
    candidate_tbl$term_pattern,
    function(current_pattern) {
      stringr::str_detect(
        term_name,
        stringr::regex(current_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  ))
  if (length(detected) == 0L) return(NA_character_)
  candidate_tbl$functional_family[[detected[[1]]]]
}

paper_function_assignment_audit <- module_goseq_significant %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$module_label %in% c("MEgreen", "MEturquoise")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$module,
    .data$module_label,
    ontology = clean_chr(.data$ontology),
    go_id = clean_chr(.data$category),
    term_name = dplyr::coalesce(
      clean_chr(.data$term),
      clean_chr(.data$category)
    ),
    module_fdr = .data$module_over_represented_FDR,
    fold_enrichment = .data$fold_enrichment,
    n_module_genes_in_term = .data$n_module_genes_in_term,
    matched_module_genes = clean_chr(.data$matched_module_genes)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$term_name),
    !stringr::str_detect(
      .data$term_name,
      stringr::regex(generic_go_parent_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    functional_family = purrr::map2_chr(
      .data$module_label,
      .data$term_name,
      assign_paper_function_family
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    .data$matched_module_genes,
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_id = clean_chr(.data$matched_module_genes)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.data$matched_module_genes) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_membership %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$gene_id,
        .data$best_gene_label
      ),
    by = "gene_id"
  )

paper_function_family_summary <- paper_function_assignment_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$functional_family)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$module_label,
    .data$functional_family
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_go_terms = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$go_id),
    n_unique_module_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$gene_id[!is.na(.data$gene_id)]
    ),
    minimum_fdr = safe_min(.data$module_fdr),
    representative_terms = collapse_unique(
      .data$term_name[order(.data$module_fdr)],
      max_n = 4
    ),
    representative_genes = collapse_unique(
      .data$best_gene_label[order(.data$module_fdr)],
      max_n = 8
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    paper_function_dictionary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module_label,
        .data$functional_family,
        .data$family_order
      ),
    by = c("module_label", "functional_family")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$n_go_terms >= 2L) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$module_label, .data$family_order)

primary_go_coverage <- module_goseq_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$mapping_version == "primary_eggnog") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$module_label,
    module_size_go = .data$n_module_genes,
    .data$n_module_genes_with_go
  )

write_csv_safe(
  paper_function_dictionary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "paper_facing_module_function_dictionary.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  paper_function_assignment_audit,
  file.path(tables_dir, "paper_facing_module_function_assignment_audit.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  paper_function_family_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "paper_facing_module_function_summary.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  module_composition,
  file.path(tables_dir, "paper_facing_module_composition.csv")
)

module_display_lookup <- module_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$module_label %in% c(
      "MEturquoise",
      "MEgreen",
      "MEmagenta"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$module_label,
    module_display = paste0(
      stringr::str_to_title(.data$module),
      " module (",
      .data$n_genes,
      " genes)"
    )
  )

profile_data <- module_eigengene_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label %in% main_figure_modules) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = as.character(.data$sample_code),
    site = factor(as.character(.data$site), levels = site_order),
    .data$module_label,
    eigengene = .data$module_eigengene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_display_lookup,
    by = "module_label"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_display = factor(
      .data$module_display,
      levels = module_display_lookup$module_display[
        match(
          main_figure_modules,
          module_display_lookup$module_label
        )
      ]
    )
  )

profile_summary <- profile_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$module_label,
    .data$module_display,
    .data$site
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_eigengene = mean(.data$eigengene),
    standard_error = stats::sd(.data$eigengene) / sqrt(.data$n),
    confidence_low = .data$mean_eigengene -
      stats::qt(0.975, df = .data$n - 1) * .data$standard_error,
    confidence_high = .data$mean_eigengene +
      stats::qt(0.975, df = .data$n - 1) * .data$standard_error,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

panel_a <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  profile_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$site,
    y = .data$eigengene
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 4.5),
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    colour = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(
    ggplot2::aes(fill = .data$module_label),
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.6,
    stroke = 0.45,
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = profile_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      y = .data$mean_eigengene,
      group = .data$module_label
    ),
    linewidth = 0.68,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    data = profile_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$site,
      ymin = .data$confidence_low,
      ymax = .data$confidence_high,
      group = .data$module_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.13,
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = profile_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      y = .data$mean_eigengene,
      fill = .data$module_label
    ),
    shape = 23,
    size = 3.8,
    stroke = 0.65
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~module_display,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = module_plot_colours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "A. Site-associated module eigengene profiles",
    x = "Sampling site",
    y = "Oriented module eigengene"
  ) +
  theme_wgcna_publication() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
      fill = "#F6F7F7",

    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

forest_data <- paper_module_decision_site %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label %in% main_figure_modules) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contrast_display = paste0(
      stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME")
      ),
      ": ",
      .data$numerator_site,
      " - ",
      .data$denominator_site
    ),
    contrast_display = factor(
      .data$contrast_display,
      levels = rev(.data$contrast_display)
    ),
    robustness_label = paste0(
      "q=",
      formatC(.data$q_global_planned, digits = 3, format = "f"),
      "; LOO ",
      scales::percent(
        .data$loo_direction_consistency,
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      "; bootstrap ",
      scales::percent(
        .data$bootstrap_direction_consistency,
        accuracy = 1
      )
    )
  )

forest_plot_data <- forest_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    contrast_display = paste0(
      stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_remove(.data$module_label, "^ME")
      ),
      ": ",
      .data$numerator_site,
      " vs ",
      .data$denominator_site
    ),
    contrast_display = factor(
      .data$contrast_display,
      levels = rev(.data$contrast_display)
    ),
    robustness_label = paste0(
      "q = ",
      formatC(.data$q_global_planned, digits = 3, format = "f"),
      ";\nLOO ",
      scales::percent(.data$loo_direction_consistency, accuracy = 1),
      ";\nbootstrap ",
      scales::percent(.data$bootstrap_direction_consistency, accuracy = 1)
    )
  )

forest_range <- range(
  c(
    forest_plot_data$confidence_low,
    forest_plot_data$confidence_high,
    forest_plot_data$bootstrap_confidence_low,
    forest_plot_data$bootstrap_confidence_high
  ),
  finite = TRUE
)
forest_padding <- diff(forest_range) * 0.08
if (!is.finite(forest_padding) || forest_padding == 0) {
  forest_padding <- 0.05
}

panel_b <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  forest_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    y = .data$contrast_display,
    colour = .data$module_label
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey45"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(
    ggplot2::aes(
      xmin = .data$bootstrap_confidence_low,
      xmax = .data$bootstrap_confidence_high
    ),
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(
    ggplot2::aes(
      xmin = .data$confidence_low,
      xmax = .data$confidence_high

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data$eigengene_difference),
    size = 3.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = forest_range[[2]] + forest_padding,
      label = .data$robustness_label
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    colour = "#263238",

    lineheight = 1.08
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(

  ) +

    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(7, 135, 7, 10),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, colour = "#263238")
  )

composition_long <- module_composition %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label %in% main_figure_modules) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_display_lookup,
    by = "module_label"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .data$module_label,
    .data$module_display,
    `Focal DEGs` = .data$n_focal_deg,
    `Other module genes` = .data$n_non_deg_module_genes
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Focal DEGs`, `Other module genes`),
    names_to = "gene_class",
    values_to = "n_genes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fraction = .data$n_genes / sum(.data$n_genes),
    count_label = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$fraction >= 0.09,
      as.character(.data$n_genes),
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_display = factor(
      .data$module_display,
      levels = module_display_lookup$module_display[
        match(
          main_figure_modules,
          module_display_lookup$module_label
        )
      ]
    ),
    gene_class = factor(
      .data$gene_class,
      levels = c("Other module genes", "Focal DEGs")
    )
  )

composition_plot_data <- composition_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    focal_genes = sum(.data$n_genes[.data$gene_class == "Focal DEGs"]),
    cumulative_start = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$gene_class == "Focal DEGs",
      0,
      .data$focal_genes
    ),
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$gene_class == "Focal DEGs" & .data$n_genes <= 80 ~
        .data$cumulative_start + .data$n_genes * 0.14,
      TRUE ~ .data$cumulative_start + .data$n_genes / 2
    ),
    label_hjust = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$gene_class == "Focal DEGs" & .data$n_genes <= 80,
      0,
      0.5
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_colour = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$gene_class == "Focal DEGs",
      "#FFFFFF",
      "#263238"
    )
  )

panel_c <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  composition_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$n_genes,
    y = .data$module_display,
    fill = .data$gene_class
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.62,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(

      x = .data$label_x,
      label = .data$count_label,
      colour = .data$label_colour,
      hjust = .data$label_hjust
    ),
    position = "identity",
    size = 4.1
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other module genes" = "#D0D0D0",
      "Focal DEGs" = "#404040"
    ),
    breaks = c("Focal DEGs", "Other module genes")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_identity(guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.02))

  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "C. Module composition in focal contrasts",
    x = "Genes",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_wgcna_publication() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12.5, colour = "#263238")
  )

function_plot_data <- paper_function_family_summary %>%

}
```

**Figure legend.** Site-associated co-expression modules retained after the
predefined site-contrast, module-stability, and contrast-sensitivity gates. (A)
Individual-library module eigengene values across the six sampling sites;
diamonds and error bars show site means and 95% confidence intervals. Dotted
vertical lines mark the H2–H3 and H5–H6 transitions. (B) Planned contrast
estimates. Thin intervals are model-based 95% confidence intervals, while thick
pale intervals are site-stratified bootstrap 95% intervals. Labels report global
BH-adjusted *q*-values and the proportions of leave-one-out and bootstrap
estimates retaining the fitted direction. (C) Contrast-specific DEGs and the
remaining genes in each complete module. (D) Specific, traceable whole-module
functional families assigned from primary-mapping FDR GO terms after excluding
generic parent terms. Module eigengene signs are arbitrary. Differential-
expression and co-expression analyses summarize the same libraries and provide
complementary rather than independent evidence.

## Supplementary magenta-module profile

```{r supplementary-magenta-module-figure, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.5, out.width="80%"}
magenta_profile <- module_eigengene_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == "MEmagenta")
magenta_summary <- magenta_profile %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_eigengene = mean(.data$module_eigengene),
    standard_error = stats::sd(.data$module_eigengene) / sqrt(.data$n),
    confidence_low = .data$mean_eigengene -
      stats::qt(0.975, df = .data$n - 1) * .data$standard_error,
    confidence_high = .data$mean_eigengene +
      stats::qt(0.975, df = .data$n - 1) * .data$standard_error,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

magenta_decision <- paper_module_decision_site %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == "MEmagenta")
magenta_composition <- module_composition %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$module_label == "MEmagenta")

magenta_figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  magenta_profile,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$site,
    y = .data$module_eigengene
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 4.5,
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.3,
    fill = module_plot_colours[["MEmagenta"]],
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.82
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = magenta_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      y = .data$mean_eigengene,
      group = 1
    ),
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    data = magenta_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$site,
      ymin = .data$confidence_low,
      ymax = .data$confidence_high
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.13
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = magenta_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(y = .data$mean_eigengene),
    shape = 23,
    size = 3.2,
    fill = module_plot_colours[["MEmagenta"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Magenta site-associated module (",
      magenta_composition$module_size[[1]],
      " genes)"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "H6 - H5 = ",
      formatC(
        magenta_decision$eigengene_difference[[1]],
        digits = 3,
        format = "f"
      ),
      "; global q = ",
      formatC(
        magenta_decision$q_global_planned[[1]],
        digits = 3,
        format = "f"
      ),
      "; ",
      magenta_composition$n_focal_deg[[1]],
      " focal DEGs and ",
      magenta_composition$n_non_deg_module_genes[[1]],
      " other module genes"
    ),
    x = "Sampling site",
    y = "Oriented module eigengene",
    caption = paste(
      "The module is retained as a stable descriptive pattern, but sparse",
      "annotation prevents pathway-level interpretation."
    )
  ) +
  theme_publication(base_size = 10)

save_plot_bundle(
  magenta_figure,
  file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_S_WGCNA_magenta_module"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5
)

magenta_figure
```

# 12. Exploratory interpretation

```{r exploratory-interpretation, results='asis'}
n_site_fdr <- sum(
  module_site_omnibus$site_q < site_fdr_threshold,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
n_planned_fdr <- sum(
  module_planned_contrasts$q_global_planned < contrast_fdr_threshold,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
n_primary_modules <- module_site_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$n_global_fdr_contrasts > 0,
    .data$stability_gate_pass
  ) %>%
  nrow()
n_main_figure_modules <- length(main_figure_modules)
n_large_nominal <- sum(
  module_planned_contrasts$large_nominal_effect,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
n_modules_with_go <- sum(
  module_functional_summary$n_significant_go_terms > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
n_modules_with_rrvgo <- nrow(module_rrvgo_summary)
n_modules_with_kegg <- sum(
  module_kegg_summary$n_module_fdr_terms > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
primary_go_genes <- go_mapping_cleaning_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$mapping_version == "primary_eggnog") %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$n_clean_genes) %>%
  first_or_na(NA_integer_)
union_go_genes <- go_mapping_cleaning_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$mapping_version == "sensitivity_union") %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data$n_clean_genes) %>%
  first_or_na(NA_integer_)
n_noncurrent_go_ids <- sum(
  go_identifier_audit$go_id_status != "current",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat("## Analytical outcome\n\n")
cat(
  "The site-first screen evaluated ",
  nrow(module_site_omnibus),
  " assigned modules across 30 individual libraries. ",
  n_site_fdr,
  " modules met FDR < 0.05 in the supplementary omnibus overview. ",
  n_planned_fdr,
  " of the ",
  nrow(module_planned_contrasts),
  " primary planned module-contrast tests met global FDR < 0.05; ",
  n_primary_modules,
  " distinct modules also passed the formal membership-stability gate, and ",
  n_main_figure_modules,
  " passed the additional contrast-level robustness rule for main-text display. ",
  n_large_nominal,
  " planned tests combined nominal p < 0.05 with an absolute model-standardized effect >= ",
  format(large_effect_abs_standardized, nsmall = 2),
  ". Pairwise Hedges' g is retained only as an archival diagnostic and does not rank modules.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Whole-module enrichment identified at least one module-level FDR GO term in ",
  n_modules_with_go,
  " assigned modules. Ontology-specific Wang reduction produced representative term clusters for ",
  n_modules_with_rrvgo,
  " modules, while the separate supportive KEGG family identified at least one FDR pathway in ",
  n_modules_with_kegg,
  " modules. These results describe the functional composition of complete modules rather than only the subsets already recovered through differential expression.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "The primary EggNOG GO mapping retained annotations for ",
  primary_go_genes,
  " of the ",
  format(selected_network_gene_n, big.mark = ","),
  " network genes. The broader Trinotate-union sensitivity mapping retained ",
  union_go_genes,
  " genes and is reported only as a robustness comparison. The current GO.db audit flagged ",
  n_noncurrent_go_ids,
  " obsolete or unresolved identifiers. Paper-facing functional families exclude generic GO parents and remain traceable to their source terms and module genes.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat("## Modules by focal transition\n\n")

leading_by_contrast <- module_planned_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast, .data$contrast_panel) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    .data$q_global_planned,
    .data$p_value,
    dplyr::desc(abs(.data$eigengene_difference)),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 2) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_functional_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        .data$n_significant_go_terms,
        .data$leading_theme
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    module_stability_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module,
        .data$module_label,
        .data$stability_class,
        .data$stability_gate_pass
      ),
    by = c("module", "module_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    paper_module_decision_site %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$module_label,
        .data$contrast,
        .data$contrast_robustness_pass,
        .data$paper_role
      ),
    by = c("module_label", "contrast")
  )

for (current_contrast in planned_contrasts$contrast) {
  current_rows <- leading_by_contrast %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$contrast == .env$current_contrast)

  if (nrow(current_rows) == 0L) next

  cat(
    "**",
    first_or_na(current_rows$contrast_panel, current_contrast),
    ".** "
  )

  row_text <- purrr::pmap_chr(
    current_rows,
    function(...) {
      row <- list(...)
      paste0(
        row$module_label,
        " (difference = ",
        sprintf("%.3f", row$eigengene_difference),
        ", model-standardized effect = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", row$model_standardized_effect),
        ", global q = ",
        sprintf("%.3f", row$q_global_planned),
        "; stability = ",
        row$stability_class,
        ifelse(
          is.na(row$paper_role),
          "",
          paste0("; paper role = ", row$paper_role)
        ),
        "; leading whole-module theme: ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(row$leading_theme),
          "not resolved",
          row$leading_theme
        ),
        ")"
      )
    }
  )

  cat(paste(row_text, collapse = "; "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
}

cat("## Interpretation boundary\n\n")
cat(
  "Only modules supported in the globally adjusted ",
  nrow(module_planned_contrasts),
  "-test planned-contrast family and passing the declared membership-stability gate are eligible for a primary module-level claim. Main-text display additionally requires a contrast direction that survives every focal leave-one-out refit and at least 95% of site-stratified bootstrap samples. Whole-module enrichment, focal DEG overlap, and interpretable high-kME genes strengthen biological interpretation but are complementary summaries of the same transcriptomic dataset, not independent replication. Chemistry and MoA profiles are applied only after biological selection and cannot establish chemical causation.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# 13. Automated quality-control gates

```{r final-quality-control}
current_stability_metadata <- if (file.exists(stability_metadata_file)) {
  readr::read_csv(stability_metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}
stability_fingerprint_matches <-
  nrow(current_stability_metadata) == 1L &&
  identical(
    canonicalize_scheme_signature(
      as.character(current_stability_metadata$scheme_signature[[1]])
    ),
    canonicalize_scheme_signature(stability_scheme_signature)
  ) &&
  identical(
    as.character(current_stability_metadata$stability_status[[1]]),
    "complete"
  )

current_rmd_path <- tryCatch(
  knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
  error = function(error) NA_character_
)
if (is.na(current_rmd_path) || !file.exists(current_rmd_path)) {
  current_rmd_path <- file.path(
    project_dir,
    "08_Holtemme_Site_Associated_Module_Functional_Exploration.Rmd"
  )
}
source_lines <- readLines(current_rmd_path, warn = FALSE)
hard_coded_family_pattern <- paste0(
  "\\b(", paste(c(13L, 17L, 39L, 51L), collapse = "|"),
  ") (assigned )?(modules?|tests?)\\b"
)
stale_five_thousand_pattern <- paste0(
  "selected (the )?", "5", ",?000", "-gene|",
  "5", ",?000", "-gene (network|universe) is selected"
)
stale_colour_pattern <- paste0(
  "(", paste(c(paste0("ME", "turquoise"), paste0("ME", "green")), collapse = "|"),
  ") (module|result)"
)

qc_checks <- tibble::tribble(
  ~check_id, ~passed, ~observed, ~requirement,
  "exactly_30_libraries",
  nrow(module_eigengene_sample) == 30L,
  as.character(nrow(module_eigengene_sample)),
  "30 individual RNA-seq libraries",
  "exactly_6_sites",
  nrow(sample_site_qc) == 6L,
  as.character(nrow(sample_site_qc)),
  "six sites",
  "five_libraries_per_site",
  all(sample_site_qc$n_libraries == 5L),
  paste(sample_site_qc$n_libraries, collapse = ";"),
  "five libraries at every site",
  "unique_sample_identifiers",
  !anyDuplicated(module_eigengene_sample$sample_code),
  as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(module_eigengene_sample$sample_code)),
  "all sample identifiers unique",
  "unique_gene_identifiers",
  !anyDuplicated(gene_membership$gene_id),
  as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(gene_membership$gene_id)),
  "all network gene identifiers unique",
  "requested_equals_retained_gene_count",
  selected_network_gene_n == declared_network_gene_n,
  paste(selected_network_gene_n, declared_network_gene_n, sep = "/"),
  "retained/requested gene count equality",
  "finite_positive_expression_variance",
  nrow(network_expression_variance_qc) == selected_network_gene_n &&
    all(network_expression_variance_qc$finite_positive_variance),
  as.character(sum(network_expression_variance_qc$finite_positive_variance)),
  "every network gene has finite positive variance",
  "valid_goseq_length_values",
  nrow(network_universe_lengths) == selected_network_gene_n &&
    all(is.finite(network_universe_lengths$bias_length)) &&
    all(network_universe_lengths$bias_length > 0),
  as.character(nrow(network_universe_lengths)),
  "valid positive length for every network gene",
  "minimum_assigned_module_size",
  all(assigned_module_sizes >= declared_minimum_module_size),
  as.character(min(assigned_module_sizes)),
  paste0(">= ", declared_minimum_module_size, " genes"),
  "exact_grey_excluded_from_tests",
  !"MEgrey" %in% module_planned_contrasts$module_label,
  paste(sort(unique(module_planned_contrasts$module_label)), collapse = ";"),
  "exact MEgrey absent from assigned-module tests",
  "module_labels_match_eigengenes",
  setequal(module_summary$module_label, all_me_columns),
  paste(length(module_summary$module_label), length(all_me_columns), sep = "/"),
  "final colour and eigengene label sets identical",
  "dynamic_primary_test_family",
  nrow(module_planned_contrasts) == expected_primary_test_family_n,
  paste(nrow(module_planned_contrasts), expected_primary_test_family_n, sep = "/"),
  "valid non-grey modules multiplied by three contrasts",
  "all_three_deg_contrasts_loaded",
  nrow(focal_deg_input_audit) == 3L &&
    all(focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n > 0),
  paste(focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n, collapse = ";"),
  "all three focal contrasts non-empty",
  "h6_h5_deg_nonzero",
  focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n[
    focal_deg_input_audit$contrast == "HOL05_vs_HOL04"
  ] > 0,
  as.character(focal_deg_input_audit$final_deg_n[
    focal_deg_input_audit$contrast == "HOL05_vs_HOL04"
  ]),
  "H6-H5 DEG count greater than zero",
  "declared_14_network_stability_scheme",
  nrow(stability_design) == 14L && all(module_stability_summary$n_variants == 14L),
  paste(nrow(stability_design), unique(module_stability_summary$n_variants), sep = "/"),
  "10 resamples plus four parameter variants",
  "stability_cache_fingerprint_match",
  stability_fingerprint_matches,
  as.character(stability_fingerprint_matches),
  "cache metadata identical to current inputs and settings",
  "no_hard_coded_module_or_family_counts",
  !any(grepl(hard_coded_family_pattern, source_lines, perl = TRUE)),
  as.character(sum(grepl(hard_coded_family_pattern, source_lines, perl = TRUE))),
  "no stale hard-coded module or test-family counts",
  "no_stale_5000_gene_selection",
  !any(grepl(stale_five_thousand_pattern, source_lines, ignore.case = TRUE)),
  as.character(sum(grepl(stale_five_thousand_pattern, source_lines, ignore.case = TRUE))),
  "no stale 5,000-gene final-selection narrative",
  "no_stale_colour_claim",
  !any(grepl(stale_colour_pattern, source_lines, ignore.case = TRUE)),
  as.character(sum(grepl(stale_colour_pattern, source_lines, ignore.case = TRUE))),
  "no retained claim tied to an old module colour",
  "contrast_robustness_complete",
  nrow(contrast_robustness) == 3L &&
    all(is.finite(contrast_robustness$loo_direction_consistency)) &&
    all(is.finite(contrast_robustness$bootstrap_direction_consistency)),
  paste(nrow(contrast_robustness), contrast_bootstrap_replicates, sep = "/"),
  "three focal modules with complete leave-one-out and bootstrap diagnostics",
  "green_retained_for_main_figure",
  "MEgreen" %in% main_figure_modules,
  paste(main_figure_modules, collapse = ";"),
  "green retained after primary, stability, and contrast-robustness gates",
  "final_wgcna_figure_written",
  file.exists(file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_WGCNA_site_associated_modules_final.png")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_WGCNA_site_associated_modules_final.pdf")),
  paste(
    file.exists(file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_WGCNA_site_associated_modules_final.png")),
    file.exists(file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_WGCNA_site_associated_modules_final.pdf")),
    sep = ";"
  ),
  "final PNG and PDF figure files present",
  "chemistry_excluded_from_module_selection",
  isFALSE(chemistry_overlay_status$chemistry_used_for_module_selection[[1]]),
  as.character(chemistry_overlay_status$chemistry_used_for_module_selection[[1]]),
  "chemistry overlay is downstream context only"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    status = dplyr::if_else(.data$passed, "PASS", "FAIL")
  )

write_csv_safe(
  qc_checks,
  file.path(tables_dir, "final_wgcna_quality_control_gates.csv")
)
knitr::kable(
  qc_checks,
  caption = "Automated final WGCNA quality-control gates."
)

if (any(!qc_checks$passed)) {
  stop(
    "Final WGCNA QC gate(s) failed: ",
    paste(qc_checks$check_id[!qc_checks$passed], collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```
